title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (OCR, English)
jd_text:
At Topicus, we believe IT should serve society. From healthcare and education to finance, our solutions empower millions of people daily by turning complex challenges into user-friendly platforms. We don’t just build software; we increase self-reliance and reduce vulnerability for citizens worldwide. With a team of over 1,800+ "Topicans" across Southeast Asia (Vietnam & Thailand) and Europe (the Netherlands, Romania, Portugal, and Iceland), we are constantly expanding our horizons. Our ambition reaches far beyond Europe, driven by a shared mission to make a meaningful difference. We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer to build a next-generation AI-powered OCR platform for the financial industry. This solution processes large volumes of financial documents using modern machine learning and computer vision techniques to automate document recognition, extraction and validation. The product is part of Akkuro, one of the leading composable banking platforms. Our Vietnam team will independently own and further develop this product, giving you significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence its future direction. Design, develop, and optimize AI-powered OCR solutions in Python. Build and improve machine learning models for document recognition and data extraction. Process and analyze large datasets using Pandas and related data processing libraries. Train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models using TensorFlow or similar frameworks. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, testers, and software engineers. Improve model accuracy, performance, and scalability. Investigate new AI technologies and propose improvements to the product. Take ownership of technical decisions and mentor other engineers.

5+ years of experience developing Python applications. Strong experience with machine learning and AI. Experience with TensorFlow (or similar frameworks such as PyTorch). Excellent knowledge of Pandas and data processing. Experience working with OCR, computer vision, or document processing is a strong advantage. Familiarity with REST APIs and cloud-based deployments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent English communication skills (communication with international stakeholders).

title: AI Automation Engineer (Senior/Lead)
jd_text:
1. Technical Leadership & Team Development: Senior level: Lead the design, development, and implementation of AI-powered automation solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and best practices for automation tooling and AI-assisted workflows. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, well-documented, and reusable across projects and titles. Lead level: Lead and mentor a team of AI Automation Engineers. Provide technical direction and code-level leadership across automation initiatives. Define and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices for automation and AI-assisted workflows. Drive the development of scalable, maintainable, and reusable solutions across multiple titles. Support team growth, hiring, and capability development as the studio expands. 2. Hands-on Automation Engineering Design and implement automation tools and scripts that eliminate repetitive operational work. Build reusable operational tooling that can be used across multiple game teams. Collaborate directly with Game Engineers and technical owners to automate operational tasks. Maintain and evolve internal tooling used for LiveOps operations, QA workflows, and release support. 3. AI-Assisted Engineering and Tooling Promote practical adoption of AI-assisted development tools within automation workflows. Experiment with AI-driven approaches to automation generation, log analysis, and operational diagnostics. Identify opportunities where AI can improve debugging, operational insight, and engineering productivity. Work with technical leadership to ensure responsible and effective use of AI across the studio. 4. Operational Efficiency and Workflow Improvements Identify and reduce manual work across LiveOps, QA, and operational processes through targeted automation. Design and implement scalable workflows and reusable tooling to improve consistency and engineering leverage across titles. Address root causes of operational issues and implement preventive improvements to reduce recurrence and increase reliability. 5. Monitoring and Operational Visibility Improve monitoring, logging, and diagnostics to provide clear and reliable visibility into production systems. Build tools that enable engineers to quickly understand system behavior and investigate issues in production. Strengthen observability and alerting practices to enable faster detection and more effective troubleshooting of incidents. 6. Collaboration with DevOps and Platform Teams Work with the central DevOps team when automation interacts with deployment pipelines or infrastructure systems. Collaborate with the platform teams when automation interacts with shared services, internal tools or platform capabilities. Ensure studio automation tooling aligns with existing platform and DevOps standards. Focus primarily on automation and engineering tooling , rather than infrastructure ownership.

REQUIREMENTS 4+ years of experience in software engineering, developer tooling, or automation. Good command of written and spoken English. Strong scripting or programming skills (at least one of the following: C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or similar). Experience building automation tools, developer tooling, or operational systems. Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of engineering workflows. (Claude Code, OpenCode, LangChain, Codex, Devin...) Strong understanding of software development workflows and engineering productivity tools. Preferred Experience Experience mentoring or leading engineers in a technical capacity. Experience working on live products or operational systems . Experience building internal developer tools or automation frameworks . Exposure to monitoring, logging, and operational diagnostics tooling. Basic understanding of CI/CD systems or cloud infrastructure. Additional Notes: Infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities are primarily handled by the central DevOps team. Experience in these areas is helpful but not required. You may be expected to complete a test as part of the interviewing procedure.

jd_text:
We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to operate and optimize our High-Availability Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, with a primary focus on Private Cloud (OpenStack) supporting mission-critical Digital Financial Products & Infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience in production OpenStack environments, with solid capabilities in Linux, networking, automation, and infrastructure troubleshooting Key Responsibilities 1. Private Cloud – OpenStack (Primary Focus) Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade production OpenStack Private Cloud environments. Deploy and manage OpenStack using Kolla-Ansible, TripleO, Genestack, or equivalent. Operate core OpenStack services including Nova, Neutron, Keystone, Glance, and Horizon. Maintain HA, performance, capacity, and reliability of the Private Cloud platform. Perform infrastructure troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity planning, upgrades, and lifecycle management. Handle production incidents, perform RCA, and continuously improve operational stability. 2. Public Cloud – AWS & GCP Operate and support infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP. Support connectivity between Private Cloud and Public Cloud environments. Monitor resource utilization, availability, performance, and infrastructure cost. 3. Kubernetes & Automation Operate and support production Kubernetes environments. Use Terraform and Ansible to automate infrastructure provisioning and operational tasks. Support CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. 4. Monitoring, Security & Operations Operate infrastructure monitoring and logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, and ELK/Elastic Stack. Participate in on-call, incident management, and ensure defined SLA/SLO targets.

title: Senior SOC Engineer
jd_text:
Chịu trách nhiệm theo dõi, phản ứng, ngăn chặn các cuộc tấn công vào hệ thống nhằm đảm bảo duy trì hoạt động kinh doanh liên tục của công ty. Thực hiện giám sát toàn bộ hệ thống thông tin, nhằm phát hiện các dấu hiệu bất thường, vi phạm, tấn công vào hệ thống. Chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng và đề xuất các giải pháp thực hiện hỗ trợ cho việc giám sát và điều tra ANTT. Chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng các quy trình/hướng dẫn cho nghiệp vụ giám sát và điều tra ANTT. Chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng các quy trình/kịch bản phản ứng trước các sự cố ANTT. 1. Quản trị chung: Xây dựng và bảo vệ kế hoạch cá nhân hàng năm với phòng Tham gia Xây dựng và cập nhật liên tục chiến lược Giám Sát An Ninh Thông Tin Xây dựng và bảo vệ KPI cá nhân hàng năm Tham gia xây dựng và bảo vệ KPI cho nhóm Hỗ Trợ Trưởng Phòng lên ngân sách hoạt động hàng năm Đề xuất và tham gia đào tạo Không ngừng tìm kiếm và khẩn trương thực hiện các cơ hội cải tiến chất lượng dịch vụ khách hàng Triển khai các giải pháp nâng cao tính “khách hàng là trọng tâm” và cải thiện trải nghiệm của khách hàng. 2. Giám Sát An Ninh Thông Tin - Security Monitor * Tình báo công nghệ và săn tìm mối nguy - Threat Intelligence & Hunting Thu thập thông tin tình báo hàng ngày và đánh giá tác động đến SSI Quản lý tiến trình cập nhật mẫu nhận diện mối đe dọa lên hệ thống bảo mật Chủ động săn tìm các mối đe dọa trên hệ thống * Phản ứng sự cố an ninh thông tin - Incident response Chịu trách nhiệm xử lý và phản ứng các sự cố ANTT Thực hiện các công việc liên quan đến phân tích malaware và reverse engineering Chịu trách nhiêm xây dựng các kịch bản phản ứng sự cố và diễn tập Định nghĩa phương thức giao tiếp với các tổ chức và cơ quan thực thi pháp luật nếu có sự cố bảo mật * Giám sát an ninh thông tin - Security monitoring Thực hiện giám sát toàn bộ hệ thống thông tin, nhằm phát hiện các dấu hiệu bất thường, vi phạm, tấn công vào hệ thống. Thực hiện điều tra truy vết để xác định nguồn gốc, đối tượng vi phạm, tấn công vào hệ thống thông tin. Thực hiện cấu hình tối ưu các hệ thống giám sát ANTT nhằm phát hiện chính xác các vi phạm/tấn công. Chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng logs baseline cho các hệ thống thông tin Chịu trách nhiêm xây dựng các báo cáo định kỳ về tình hình giám sát ANTT * Điều tra số - Digital forensic Thực hiện điều tra truy vết để xác định nguồn gốc, đối tượng vi phạm, tấn công vào hệ thống thông tin. 3. Rủi Ro Công Nghệ và Kểm Soát Tuân Thủ - Technology Risk and Compliant * Chính sách - Policy Tham gia xây dụng chính sách, tiêu chuẩn,hướng dẫn an ninh thông tin * Quản trị rủi ro - Risk Management​ Nhận diện, theo dõi, thực thi các kiểm soát nhằm hạn chế các rủi ro giám sát cho hệ thống an ninh bảo mật. Thông báo các rủi ro ngăn việc đạt được các mục tiêu công việc và thực hiện các hành động phù hợp để hạn chế các rủi ro này. * Tuân Thủ - Compliant Thường xuyên cập nhật chính sách, thủ tục cũng như các yêu cầu về mặt pháp lý bên ngoài.

Yêu cầu có bằng ĐH, chuyên ngành máy tính hoặc An toàn thông tin Có kinh nghiệm làm An ninh thông tin từ 1 năm trở lên Kinh nghiệm về việc điều tra và xử lý các sự cố ANTT Có kinh nghiệm về các sản phẩm phục vụ phân tích và điều tra ANTT: Hệ thống quản lý và phân tích sự kiện, Công cụ điều phân tích và điều tra ANTT Có kinh nghiệm về theo dõi giám sát, điều tra và truy vết các xâm nhập vào hệ thống CNTT

title: Medior Enterprise Security Architect
jd_text:
REPORT TO: Group Security Manager (CISO) JOB PURPOSE: - The Medior Enterprise Security Architect defines, maintains and operationalizes architecture for security services and security solutions across De Heus. The role translates security policy and principles into practical security design patterns, guardrails and approval criteria that can be applied consistently across regions and business units. - The role provides the security authority to review, challenge and approve designs produced by Cloud & Infra, Applications, Data & Analytics, OT and other teams from a security perspective, ensuring alignment with global security guardrails, standards and risk decisions. The role does not own or replace the full architecture responsibility of those teams; those teams remain responsible for secure designs within their own domains. - The architect supports architecture reviews, service catalog development, exception handling and security design decisions, while working closely with a senior architecture counterpart during the transition period. ACCOUNTABILITIES: 1. Security Architecture Definition & Maintenance - Define and maintain architecture for security services and security solutions across De Heus. - Develop practical security design patterns, standards interpretations and guardrails for regional and local execution. - Document security architecture decisions, reusable patterns and design guidance in a clear and usable way. 2. Security Design Review & Approval - Review, challenge and approve designs submitted by Cloud & Infra, Applications, Data & Analytics, OT and other teams from a security perspective. - Provide structured security feedback to improve alignment of peer-team designs with global security standards and guardrails. - Prepare security architecture review materials and support Architecture Review Board decisions and follow-up actions. 3. Security Service Catalog & Exception Governance - Contribute to the security service catalog and help define clear business, functional and technical ownership. - Support governance of exceptions, compensating controls and remediation commitments. - Help define and maintain security architecture KPIs and inputs for the central security dashboard. 4. Cross-Team Collaboration & Field Enablement - Contribute to the security service catalog and help define clear business, functional and technical ownership. - Support governance of exceptions, compensating controls and remediation commitments. - Help define and maintain security architecture KPIs and inputs for the central security dashboard. 5. Cross-Team Collaboration & Field Enablement - Work with Regional Security Delivery Specialists to enable knowledge transfer and practical security implementation guidance for business units. - Build understanding of De Heus platforms, organization, priorities and delivery model to apply security guidance in a practical and business-relevant way. - Align with the Enterprise Architect, CIO leadership and global IT functions on shared platforms and governance. 6. Professional Growth & Transition Support - Learn actively from a senior architecture counterpart during the transition period. - Build deeper knowledge of De Heus security standards, architecture governance, business priorities and platform landscape. - Continuously strengthen knowledge in security architecture, secure design principles and stakeholder management. RESULT: - A coherent set of security architecture patterns, standards and guardrails is in place and adopted across projects and regions. - Security review inputs and approval decisions are timely, clear and well documented. - Designs from peer teams show measurable improvement in alignment with global security standards and guardrails. - The security service catalog is structured and maintained with clear ownership. - Exception governance is structured and supports measurable reduction of long-term risk. - Business units and regional teams receive usable security guidance that supports implementation and handover. - The role shows measurable growth in independence, quality of review and confidence in design decisions during the transition period.

Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered. - Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, TOGAF, SABSA or relevant vendor certifications are an advantage. Experience: - Around 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in security architecture, security engineering, security solution design or closely related technical roles across IT and Cloud. Experience with OT is an advantage. - Experience translating security policies or standards into practical technical guardrails, patterns or implementation guidance. - Experience reviewing technical designs from a security perspective in collaboration with infrastructure, application, data, analytics and engineering teams. - Working knowledge of identity and access management, segmentation, secure remote access and privileged access concepts. - Familiarity with exception handling, documentation and security governance processes. - Experience within De Heus IT or in a closely related De Heus technology role is a strong advantage, because knowledge of the organization, stakeholders, platforms and ways of working can partly compensate for fewer years in a formal security architecture role. - Experience supporting implementation teams with practical security guidance and knowledge transfer is an advantage. Competencies: - Able to translate security policy and principles into practical and implementable security guidance. - Strong security review mindset and ability to assess peer-team designs objectively. - Structured and clear in documentation, architecture artefacts and service ownership thinking. - Good stakeholder engagement across global, regional and local teams. - Able to work effectively with Cloud & Infra, Applications, Data & Analytics, OT and delivery teams without role overlap. - Strong learning agility and willingness to grow into broader architecture accountability over time. - Open to coaching, feedback and structured development during the transition period. - Disciplined, reliable and comfortable working in a governance-driven environment. Language(s): - Fluency in English at CEFR Level B2 is mandatory (both written and spoken), as the role requires daily collaboration with global, regional and local teams across De Heus. Other Requirements: - Full-time global role with occasional travel. - Location independent: the role can be based at any De Heus global hub. The current preference is HCMC, Vietnam. - Reporting line into the central CISO Office; close collaboration with a senior architecture counterpart during the transition period.

title: Application Security Engineer (RedTeam/Pentest)
jd_text:
Thực hiện Red Team/Purple Team: lập kế hoạch và mô phỏng tấn công theo kịch bản thực tế để đánh giá khả năng phát hiện/ứng phó của SOC/Blue Team. Kiểm thử xâm nhập (black/white/gray box) cho Web/Mobile/API (OWASP), hệ thống core chứng khoán inhouse, giải pháp bên thứ 3 và hạ tầng (AD/Windows, Linux, server, network, endpoint). Rà quét/đánh giá lỗ hổng định kỳ; cung cấp bằng chứng khai thác (PoC/validation), phân tích root cause, hướng dẫn khắc phục và retest. Nghiên cứu 0day/1day, TTP/tooling mới, đề xuất cải tiến kiểm soát bảo mật, logging và detection trong hệ thống nội bộ. Tư vấn security cho kiến trúc giải pháp; phối hợp DevOps/Infra/AppSec/SOC để xử lý findings và nâng cao năng lực phòng thủ. Thực hiện các công việc khác theo phân công.

Kinh nghiệm offensive security tối thiểu 5 năm (ưu tiên đã làm Red Team/Purple Team/AD attack). Hiểu kiến trúc hệ thống, cơ sở dữ liệu, ứng dụng Web/Mobile, cơ chế xác thực, mã hóa dữ liệu. Thành thạo kỹ thuật tìm kiếm/phân tích/khai thác điểm yếu; viết script/automation; các kĩ thuật bypass EDR, leo thang đặc quyền,... Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu tiếng Anh; viết báo cáo rõ ràng, phối hợp đa bên tốt. Lợi thế: CTF/bug bounty, OSCP/OSWE/OSEP/CRTO/CRTE (hoặc tương đương), kinh nghiệm môi trường tài chính/chứng khoán.

title: FullStack Team Lead (.NET)
jd_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE As a Team Lead, you are responsible for leading an engineering team to deliver scalable, high-quality, and reliable solutions aligned with playCONNECT’s product and technical goals. You combine strong technical expertise with people leadership, ensuring your team operates efficiently, collaborates effectively, and continuously improves both engineering quality and delivery practices. You will act as the bridge between engineering, product, and other stakeholders (DevOps, Games, Loyalty teams, Data,…), translating requirements & priorities into actionable execution plans while fostering a healthy, high-performing, and AI-augmented engineering culture. This role requires a balance of technical leadership, delivery ownership, mentoring, and strategic thinking to ensure your team can sustainably deliver impactful products and platform capabilities. RESPONSIBILITIES Technical leadership and Execution – Own the technical execution of your team by translating product requirements into clear engineering plans, technical designs, and implementation strategies. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with engineering standards and long-term platform architecture. Review and validate Technical Design Documents and provide technical guidance throughout the development lifecycle. Sprint Delivery & Agile Execution – Lead sprint planning, estimation, prioritization, execution tracking, and delivery coordination to ensure predictable and high-quality releases. Remove blockers proactively, manage delivery risks, and continuously improve team efficiency and Agile processes. Stakeholder Alignment & Expectation Management – Act as the primary technical liaison between engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly while managing expectations around scope, timelines, and feasibility. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers, QA, and other engineering teams. AI-Augmented Engineering Culture – Drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and tools, including coding assistants, automated documentation, and productivity tooling. Encourage innovation and continuous learning while ensuring sustainable engineering practices and developer well-being. Team Health & Career Growth – Support the growth and success of team members through mentoring, coaching, feedback, and career development discussions. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and psychologically safe team culture while helping resolve interpersonal or delivery-related challenges. Technical Strategy Alignment – Ensure alignment between architectural decisions, engineering priorities, and business objectives. Partner with Tech Leads and Engineering Management to balance technical excellence, scalability, speed of execution, and product impact. Documentation Integrity – Maintain high standards for technical documentation, onboarding materials, architecture diagrams, and operational processes. Promote knowledge sharing and ensure technical information remains accurate, accessible, and up to date. Engineering Quality & Continuous Improvement - Promote engineering best practices including code quality, testing, observability, security, and performance optimization. Identify areas for process improvement and lead initiatives that improve team productivity, reliability, and operational excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS Must have: 5+ years in software engineering, with 1+ years actively leading, mentoring, and growing engineering teams across the full technology stack. Proven ability to build high-performing team cultures, balance hands-on technical guidance with people management, and support engineers through career growth and skill development. Fluent English (written and verbal) with strong interpersonal skills to manage cross-functional stakeholders, translate business goals for the team, and advocate for engineering needs. Track record of driving delivery in fast-paced product environments while fostering psychological safety, resolving interpersonal conflicts, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned. Broad expertise in modern frontend and backend architectures (e.g., .NET Core, Node.js, and modern web frontend technologies) to guide architectural decisions, manage technical debt, and uphold operational excellence. Strong problem-solving skills to help teams navigate technical risks, maintain high engineering standards, and reliably scale high-traffic consumer applications. Ability to rally the team around long-term product goals, translate big-picture feature vision into actionable engineering roadmaps, and foster continuous innovation within the team. Nice to have: Experience in gaming, loyalty, rewards, or consumer-facing platforms. Experience managing distributed or international engineering teams. Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, cloud infrastructure, and platform integration challenges. Experience implementing AI-assisted development workflows and engineering productivity tooling. Passion for mentoring and building strong engineering cultures. Additional Notes: You may be expected to complete a test as part of the interviewing procedure.

title: Product Manager / Product Director
jd_text:
We are looking for a strategic, customer-obsessed, and data-driven Head of Product to own high-impact products from vision to execution for the new international airport. You will define product strategy, lead discovery, and deliver customer-centric experiences that drive user acquisition, engagement, and long-term retention. You will lead the strategy for key Guest Platform journeys such as onboarding, Fly, Navigate, Shop, Loyalty, and AI Concierge. Strategic Responsibilities Own the Product: Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics, taking end-to-end ownership of the GBIA Guest Platform. Champion the Customer: Translate guest insights and Customer Journeys into product opportunities, concepts, and end-to-end experiences. Lead Product Discovery & Delivery: Validate ideas through research, experimentation, MVPs, and iterative development, working closely with engineering and design teams. Build Connected Experiences: Design seamless customer journeys across physical-digital interfaces, integrating airport services with lifestyle, loyalty, and fintech ecosystems to create greater value for users and partners. Drive Data-Informed Decisions: Define product KPIs, leverage analytics, and continuously optimize customer and business outcomes. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with Engineering, Design, GBIA CX, Business teams, and international aviation partners to deliver impactful products and align teams around a shared vision.

8+ years of Product Management experience, with a proven track record of launching and scaling successful digital products and leading complex product teams. Strong product discovery, customer research, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in travel, aviation, hospitality, mobility, super-app, eCommerce, fintech, or large B2C ecosystems is highly preferred. Experience with omni-channel or physical-digital experiences such as kiosks, self-service, or navigation. Strong analytical mindset with experience using product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics. Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, Agile/Scrum, and modern technology platforms. Strong stakeholder management and working English to collaborate with cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and international aviation partners.

title: Principal Security Software Engineer (Digital Banking)
jd_text:
About the Role We're building the Authentication & Authorization platform for a new FSA-regulated digital bank in Japan. The platform powers OAuth 2.0/OIDC-based login, token lifecycle, and identity management across four banking channels — officer dashboards, customer-facing apps, BaaS APIs, and third-party service provider integrations. The team is located in Vietnam HCM city with high ownership. You'll own entire auth flows end-to-end — not just write tickets. What You'll Build Token lifecycle — DPoP-bound access tokens, token exchange (RFC 8693), silent refresh, session management Passkey/FIDO2 — WebAuthn registration & login flows, step-up authentication for sensitive operations mTLS integrations — certificate-based service-to-service auth with external financial platforms Shared security library — Spring Boot starter providing standardized auth filters across all backend services Integration testing — Karate-based test suites covering all auth flows at scale Monitoring — Auth event observability, anomaly detection, audit trail completeness

Must-Have Backend Over 10 years in server-side engineering, including 5 to 7 years specializing in Kotlin or Java with Spring Boot development. Redis — session management, distributed locking, caching PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations REST API design and HTTP security headers English proficiency (reading, writing, and verbal) — the primary working language across the team and organization for daily communication, code reviews, and technical documentation. Security & Auth Strong Spring Security expertise — filter chains, OAuth2 Resource Server Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 / OIDC — authorization code, client credentials, token exchange, introspection Understanding at least one: DPoP (RFC 9449), mTLS (RFC 8705), PKCE , FIDO2/WebAuthn Familiarity with JWT structure — claims, JWKS, key rotation Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, session management, and secure web application development. Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10 — common web vulnerabilities, mitigation, and secure coding practices Infrastructure AWS — ECS/Fargate, Secrets Manager, VPC basics Terraform or similar IaC API integration testing (Karate preferred) Nice-to-Have Experience with Authlete FAPI 2.0 Security Profile or financial-grade API standards Microsoft Entra ID — SAML/OIDC federation, FIDO2 key enforcement Cloudflare/ Akamia — mTLS termination, WAF, client certificate forwarding WebAuthn/FIDO2 ceremonies — attestation, assertion, discoverable credentials Fintech/banking background — FSA regulations, maker-checker patterns, audit logging Japanese language ability (reading/basic communication) — a plus for requirement docs Why This Role 🏦 Real regulated bank — not a fintech startup, not a toy project. FSA-supervised, launching in Japan. 🔐 Cutting-edge security standards — FAPI 2.0, DPoP, WebAuthn/FIDO2. Few teams globally work at this intersection. 🚀 High ownership — small team, big scope. You'll own entire authentication channels, not just implement tickets. 🌏 Global collaboration — work with engineers across Japan, Vietnam, and India on a greenfield digital banking platform.

What You'll Build Token lifecycle — DPoP-bound access tokens, token exchange (RFC 8693), silent refresh, session management Passkey/FIDO2 — WebAuthn registration & login flows, step-up authentication for sensitive operations mTLS integrations — certificate-based service-to-service auth with external financial platforms Shared security library — Spring Boot starter providing standardized auth filters across all backend services Integration testing — Karate-based test suites covering all auth flows at scale Monitoring — Auth event observability, anomaly detection, audit trail completeness
requirements: Must-Have Backend Over 10 years in server-side engineering, including 5 to 7 years specializing in Kotlin or Java with Spring Boot development. Redis — session management, distributed locking, caching PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations REST API design and HTTP security headers English proficiency (reading, writing, and verbal) — the primary working language across the team and organization for daily communication, code reviews, and technical documentation. title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
jd_text:
Trusting Social is an AI Fintech pioneer that's revolutionizing credit access in emerging markets. Our mission is "Advancing AI to Meet the Financial Needs of Everyday Consumers with Empathy." We've assessed over 1 billion consumers across four countries, and we're on a mission to provide 100 million credit lines using the power of AI and Big Data. Join Trusting Social as a Full-Stack AI Engineer II and help build products that are transforming financial services in Vietnam and beyond. You will contribute to our Co-Lending partnership initiatives, building systems across the full stack (backend, web and mobile) that enable fast, scalable credit evaluation and secure integration with banks, partners, and third-party platforms. Your work will help power instant registration, real-time credit approval, and automated decisioning at scale. As an Engineer II, you deliver features end-to-end within a defined scope with increasing autonomy, working AI-native and broadening your skills across the full stack as you grow Deliver high-quality features end-to-end across the full stack (backend, web, mobile), working with cross-functional teams and ensuring systems are reliable, highly scalable, and fault-tolerant. Work AI-native, orchestrating agents: frame the problem for the agent, delegate the implementation, run multiple agent sessions per day, and spend your own time on direction, quality review, and the hard edge cases. Build and maintain the tests, evals, and harnesses that agents depend on, so the system stays legible and reliable. Follow Agile/DevOps and CI/CD to deliver quality code at speed. Identify and resolve technical challenges within your scope with increasing autonomy. Support and mentor new joiners, and share knowledge that raises team productivity. Continuously learn and stay current with advances in software engineering and AI technologies. Perform other work duties as assigned by the line manager. Beyond the core These are the dimensions we grow our engineers into — and it's a plus if you already operate in one or more of them: Domain expert & architect: learn a relevant partner/product area and encode its rules into reusable skills and docs that others and AI agents can reuse; contribute product and design judgment, not just implementation. Platform & operations owner: operate and monitor agent-assisted systems in production, holding the bar on reliability, security, and quality at the integration boundary. Partner-facing engineer: manage trust at the partner/client boundary within your scope, and communicate clearly across functions.

AI-native delivery: a track record of (or clear eagerness for) shipping production work by orchestrating AI coding agents — running multiple agent sessions, directing and reviewing their output, and building the tests and harnesses that keep it reliable. Full-stack engineering: solid technical foundation with 4+ years of software engineering across backend and frontend (web or mobile); experience building distributed systems, banking, or fintech is a plus. Security-aware by default: you keep data protection, access control, and auditability in mind, and are comfortable working within banking/partner compliance constraints. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for product quality and delivery timelines. A collaborative team player who contributes positively to the team environment. Proactive, open-minded, and quick to learn. Motivated to raise the bar and continuously improve products and engineering practices. Good communication skills with working proficiency in English.

title: Senior Product Owner (Personal Finance Platform)
jd_text:
Our vision is to build a Personal Banker for every Vietnamese citizen - an intelligent, empathetic, and always-available financial companion that helps ordinary people borrow, repay, and manage money affordably and with dignity. The Personal Finance Platform you will help build is the first step toward that vision. Trusting Social builds AI-powered lending in partnership with banks and financial institutions, and owns the full AI lending stack - fraud prevention, credit scoring, risk-based pricing, real-time integrations, and an AI agent. Just as important, we are remaking every team as a human–AI fusion: people set the direction and hold the judgment, while AI carries the analytical and execution load. In this role you will work alongside AI agents every day, and you will be expected to get more done, faster, because of how well you use AI. You will join the product squad building the Personal Finance Platform, working directly with the Product Lead to ship the first launch in Q4 2026. This is a hands-on execution role: you turn product direction into detailed requirements, working software, and measurable outcomes. Deep customer insight - continuously researching the financial pains, behaviours, and unmet needs of mass-market Vietnamese consumers, and turning them into product decisions. The end-to-end customer experience across the platform - making every journey simple, transparent, and trustworthy for first-time and underbanked users. Market and competitive awareness - tracking the consumer-finance market, competitor moves, and regulation, and keeping the product direction up to date. Feature discovery and detailed requirements - user stories, acceptance criteria, and PRDs - for your assigned journeys on the Personal Finance Platform. Launch execution - coordinating day-to-day with engineering, design, data, risk, and bank-partner counterparts to hit launch dates. Feature-level metrics - instrumenting, tracking, and reporting adoption and funnel performance, and proposing iterations from the data. Daily AI leverage - using AI tools to accelerate spec-writing, analysis, and testing, and verifying AI output against source data. Clear, timely communication to the squad and the Product Lead on progress, blockers, and trade-offs.

Must have A genuine passion for solving customers' real financial pains, and empathy for mass-market and underbanked consumers. 2–4 years of experience as a product owner, associate product manager, or business analyst on consumer-facing digital products. Strong requirement craft - user stories, acceptance criteria, edge-case thinking, and UAT discipline. Comfort with data - able to pull and interpret product metrics (SQL a plus) and back decisions with evidence. Proven execution and coordination across engineering, design, and data teams. Strong daily fluency with AI tools and an appetite to build AI-augmented workflows Fluent Vietnamese and English. Nice to have Domain experience in consumer finance, e-wallets or large-scale digital products Participation in a zero-to-one product launch. Hands-on experience building AI prompts, agents, or multi-step workflows. AI expectations (mandatory) Trusting Social is remaking every team as a human–AI fusion, and this role is expected to work AI-first from day one. The successful candidate must: Use multiple AI tools every day and pick the right tool for each task, adapting quickly to an unfamiliar setup. Build their own prompts and reusable multi-step AI workflows for spec-writing, analysis, and testing. Verify AI output against source data and know exactly when not to trust or use AI. Show the appetite and trajectory to grow into orchestrating AI agents and people in the team's delivery flow.

title: Senior/Lead Site Reliability Engineer (GCP) - Payments
jd_text:
ABOUT THE JOB: As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Banked , you'll be building the foundation of our system. You'll build the infrastructure and core services of our platform and CI/CD and will ensure the reliability of our mission-critical system and API's. You'll empower other engineers to build scalable, reliable, and observable systems. You'll also solve a series of interesting technical problems. We're using tools like Google Cloud, K8s, Istio, Terraform, GitHub, ArgoCD to enable our engineering team. We're also focused on building a highly observable and auditable eco-system to operate in. We don't expect people to be experts with all of the technology we use or to immediately be able to pick up all the tasks we might ask of them. We want to build an environment where people can learn and grow openly, where failure is accepted as a part of learning and there's enough support to help people be successful.

YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Be working to improve all aspects of application reliability, including monitoring, alerting, and deployment Write code, build tools and help our engineering teams to adopt them. You'll focus on increasing productivity, reliability, security, and observability Help the team improve engineering standards, tooling, and process through mentoring, guidance, and collaboration Be part of the first response team in dealing with incidents and issues our platform Help build a culture of DevOps in engineering, where engineers own their code throughout its lifetime Work with other engineers and product managers across the company to prioritize, build, measure, and iterate new features/products. Fulfil other tasks as assigned by your People Leader and/or authorized representative of NAB Vietnam from time to time. YOUR SKILL AND EXPERIENCE Significant experience in communicating and working with software teams, and working towards building inclusive, fun environments Significant experience in building and operating scalable, mission-critical environments Significant experience working with and supporting wider engineering teams with a variety of needs and experience levels Experience with public cloud environments ( Google Cloud and AWS) Experience with Kubernetes Experience building scalable deployment pipelines using tools like ArgoCD, GitHub, and Terraform A track record of building maintainable and easy to operate systems

title: Senior Golang Engineer (Backend)
jd_text:
You'll participate in the direction of the company and products, you'll be part of a small team where everyone has a voice. As a Senior Software Engineer at Banked you'll be building our core API products and back-end services. You'll use Go and its ecosystem to deliver event driven, composable and distributed systems that can be consumed either directly by our customers or by other engineers at Banked. You'll also build resilient integrations with some of our external partners and their APIs, building the core functionality of our products. YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Work with other engineers, product managers and designers across the company to prioritise, build, measure and iterate over new features or products Be part of the team responsible for building products for merchants/partners and consumers on top of our new payment network Build services and software that's fast, resilient and and meets our challenging scale, integrity and security needs Build event based, REST based or RPC based interfaces that are consumed by engineers on other teams or by our customers Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes as we grow Mentor and help grow your peers and junior engineers, as well as be open to feedback and mentoring from those around you . Fulfil other tasks as assigned by your People Leader and/or authorized representative of NAB Vietnam from time to time.

YOUR SKILL AND EXPERIENCE From 7+ years of experience as a Golang Engineer in a complex, enterprise-level development environment Significant experience in communicating and working with software teams, and working towards building inclusive, fun environments The ability to reason intelligently about complex, uncertain problems and reduce them down to clean, simple abstractions through well designed systems A track record of taking software end-to-end , from inception working alongside product managers and designers to production and beyond A track record of developing for system maintainability and ease of operation Experience developing distributed, reliable and resilient systems Substantial experience in Go, alongside a number of other languages Fluent English skills.

title: Security Operations Engineer (Expert/Senior)
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN CHỨNG KHOÁN VPS
jd_text:
1. MỤC ĐÍCH VỊ TRÍ Gia nhập đội ngũ SOC của VPS, bạn sẽ trực tiếp tham gia giám sát, điều tra và ứng phó sự cố an toàn thông tin cho hệ thống giao dịch chứng khoán và hạ tầng công nghệ trọng yếu, góp phần bảo vệ tính an toàn, liên tục và ổn định của một trong những hệ thống tài chính có yêu cầu cao về bảo mật và tính sẵn sàng. 2. MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC Chủ trì phân tích, điều tra và xử lý các sự cố an toàn thông tin có mức độ nghiêm trọng hoặc phạm vi ảnh hưởng lớn. Xác định nguyên nhân, phương thức tấn công, phạm vi ảnh hưởng và đề xuất phương án cô lập, khắc phục, phòng ngừa tái diễn. Đưa ra đánh giá chuyên môn và phương án xử lý đối với các cảnh báo, sự kiện phức tạp được chuyển lên từ các cấp vận hành trước đó. Thực hiện phân tích log, điều tra dấu vết và truy tìm các hành vi bất thường hoặc dấu hiệu xâm nhập trên hệ thống. Chủ động tìm kiếm, phát hiện các mối đe dọa tiềm ẩn, hoạt động tấn công có chủ đích và các nguy cơ ảnh hưởng đến an toàn hệ thống. Chủ trì hoặc tham gia xây dựng, rà soát và tối ưu các kịch bản giám sát, luật cảnh báo và cơ chế phát hiện trên các nền tảng bảo mật. Khai thác, phân tích thông tin về các mối đe dọa để phục vụ công tác giám sát, điều tra và ứng phó sự cố. Đánh giá hiệu quả của hệ thống giám sát và đề xuất các giải pháp nhằm nâng cao khả năng phát hiện, cảnh báo và xử lý sự cố. Xây dựng và cập nhật quy trình, kịch bản ứng phó đối với các tình huống mất an toàn thông tin. Điều phối quá trình ứng phó sự cố; phối hợp với các đơn vị CNTT, Hạ tầng, Ứng dụng, Nghiệp vụ và các bên liên quan để kiểm soát và khắc phục sự cố. title: Remote - Automation QA Lead
jd_text:
Own automation strategy, architecture, and standards across multiple products and projects. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of automation engineers — success is measured by them outperforming and outgrowing you. Design and evolve scalable test frameworks and tooling that the whole QA org adopts. Drive AI-augmented automation across the team (AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and triage) and hold AI competency as a baseline standard. Own automation coverage, reliability, and test infrastructure — CI/CD integration, reporting, and flaky-test reduction. Set and continuously raise the technical bar for automation code craftsmanship across the team. Partner with developers, product managers, architects, and QA Leads to embed quality and automation into delivery. Stay hands-on — write and review automation code, unblock the team, and set standards by example. Help build the automation talent bench — contribute actively to hiring and keep a pipeline of strong candidates warm.

6+ years in test automation with deep hands-on expertise in Playwright and TypeScript (or a strong equivalent), including test framework architecture. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and growing automation engineers. AI competency (required). Fluent in applying AI tools to automation and driving their adoption across the team. This is a baseline expectation, not a plus. Alignment with company core values (required). High autonomy, high ownership, and a bar-raising mindset. Multiplier track record — you build tooling and grow people whose combined impact far exceeds your own output. Strong programming fundamentals and a strong advocate of code craftsmanship and quality deliverables. CI/CD, test infrastructure, and DevOps tooling experience. Runs the automation function autonomously — creates clarity and standards with minimal oversight, no hand-holding. Actively seeks and hires people who challenge and stretch the team — hires for capability and growth, not for control. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; communicate well in English. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.

title: IT Manager (Infrastructure & Security)
jd_text:
As a global player in the SaaS automotive landscape, Titan Dealer Management Solutions (Titan DMS) boasts over 165 staff globally and has SaaS representation across more than 26 markets. Titan is recognised as one of the leading providers of technologically driven solutions to automotive dealers and manufacturers worldwide. Since 2009, Titan’s flagship product, Titan DMS, has been adopted by franchised automotive dealerships across Australia, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, United Kingdom, Africa, and Europe, supporting more than 45 automotive brands. The IT Manager (Infrastructure & Security) is responsible for leading Titan’s Information Technology function and ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable technology services across the organisation. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role provides strategic and operational leadership across IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, service delivery, and operational governance. Titan operates primarily across AWS and Microsoft Azure environments, with AWS as the primary platform. The successful candidate will be capable of designing, building, and running secure and scalable technology services in an AWS environment, while also supporting Titan’s Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft 365 (Office 365) environment. A strong understanding of security tools, controls, and best practices across AWS and Microsoft platforms is essential. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders, the IT Manager will drive operational excellence, strengthen Titan’s security posture, and ensure technology services effectively support business growth and global operations. Lead, mentor and develop the Information Technology team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Manage team performance, capability development, workforce planning and resource allocation. Provide strategic and technical leadership across infrastructure, cybersecurity and operational technology initiatives. Establish clear performance expectations, technical standards and delivery service objectives. Act as the senior escalation point for complex infrastructure, operational and security issues. Promote knowledge sharing, continuous learning and operational maturity across the IT function. Own the availability, performance, reliability and scalability of Titan's global IT infrastructure and enterprise platforms. Provide strategic oversight of cloud environments including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and Atlassian products. Drive infrastructure modernisation, automation, standardisation and operational excellence initiatives. Establish and maintain technology architecture standards, infrastructure lifecycle management and operational governance. Oversee backup, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities to ensure organisational resilience. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures and infrastructure standards. Oversee IT asset lifecycle management, software licensing and configuration management. Lead Titan's cybersecurity strategy and continuously improve the organisation's security posture. Develop, implement and maintain security policies, governance frameworks, operational standards and security controls. Oversee security operations including vulnerability management, threat management, security monitoring and incident response. Lead information security compliance activities including ISO 27001 certification and SOC2 Type II assurance, internal and external audits, risk assessments and continual improvement initiatives. Ensure security best practices are embedded across infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise systems and operational processes. Oversee Identity and Access Management (IAM), privileged access controls, authentication standards and user lifecycle security. Ensure IT services consistently meet agreed service levels and business expectations. Establish and monitor service performance metrics, operational KPIs and continual service improvement initiatives. Lead the management of major IT incidents, root cause analysis and post-incident improvement activities. Implement effective change management processes that minimise operational risk while supporting business agility. Drive operational excellence through automation, monitoring, observability and continual service improvement. Provide regular reporting on infrastructure health, service performance, cybersecurity risks and improvement initiatives. Build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering and Business teams to deliver secure, scalable and reliable technology solutions. Develop trusted relationships with key business stakeholders and provide strategic technology advice. Manage relationships with technology vendors, managed service providers and strategic partners. Oversee technology procurement, licensing, contract renewals and vendor performance to ensure value, compliance and service quality. Develop and execute Titan's IT infrastructure and cybersecurity roadmap aligned with organisational strategy. Identify opportunities to improve security, productivity, scalability, automation and operational efficiency. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that support innovation, resilience and long-term business objectives. Contribute to technology investment decisions, business planning and organisational transformation initiatives. Develop and manage the annual IT operating budget, including contract reviews and procurement activities. Monitor technology expenditure, identify cost optimisation opportunities and ensure effective financial governance across the IT function.

Minimum 8 years' experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, Cyber Security or related disciplines. Minimum 5 years' experience leading infrastructure, operations or technical teams, including responsibility for service delivery, operational performance and people leadership. Extensive experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure across cloud platforms, networking, cybersecurity, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity within a complex technology environment. Demonstrated experience managing AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud platforms. Strong experience administering Microsoft 365, including security, governance and modern workplace technologies. Experience administering Atlassian products including Jira, Confluence and associated platform integrations. Proven experience developing and implementing security policies, governance frameworks, risk management processes and operational controls. Hands-on experience leading ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II compliance activities, audits and continual security improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles including threat management, vulnerability management, identity and access management, security operations and incident response. Demonstrated experience managing enterprise technology vendors, contracts and service providers. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing operational budgets and technology investment decisions. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cyber Security or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated industry experience. Experience working within SaaS, software or technology-driven organisations. Experience supporting globally distributed teams. Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting and DevOps practices. AWS Certified Solutions Architect (or equivalent). Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator (or equivalent). Microsoft 365 Administrator certification. ITIL Foundation (or higher). CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification. High availability, performance and reliability of Titan's global technology platforms. Strong cybersecurity maturity and successful maintenance of ISO 27001 certification and SOC2 Type II compliance. Delivery of reliable, secure and scalable IT services that support business growth. Continuous improvement in operational efficiency through automation and technology optimisation. Effective leadership, engagement and development of the Information Technology team. Strong stakeholder satisfaction and trusted technology partnerships across the business. Effective governance of technology investments, vendor relationships and IT operating expenditure.

title: DevsecOps (Middle, Senior)
jd_text:
Lead the DevSecOps function, managing a team of DevSecOps and Site Reliability Engineers. Architect and implement CI/CD pipelines optimized for secure, compliant delivery. Own Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards across Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. Manage cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) with BFSI-grade reliability and controls. Experience with secrets management tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). Familiarity with secure SDLC, static/dynamic analysis, SAST/DAST tools. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to interact with technical and business stakeholders. Nice to have Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd). Experience in implementing observability as code. Working knowledge of zero-trust network models. Experience with Kafka, Redis, or other high-performance back-end tech. Strong documentation and reporting background.

title: Quality Engineering Expert (Automation/Performance)
jd_text:
Job Purpose Lead quality engineering for complex initiatives and specialist domains. Set the test approach, govern delivery, and combine test leadership with business analysis to ensure end-to-end quality across manual and automated testing. Key Accountabilities (1)- Automation & Performance Test Strategyy - Lead automation and performance quality engineering for complex technology initiatives. - Define automation and performance test strategy, scope, approach, quality gates, and release readiness criteria. - Own and improve automation frameworks, reusable test assets, test data, environments, execution quality, and maintainability. - Design and oversee performance testing for critical business journeys, APIs, integrations, services, and system components. - Review automation coverage, performance results, defect trends, test evidence, and release risks to provide actionable quality recommendations. (2) - Requirements Analysis & Business Collaboration - Partner with Product, Engineering, Business, BA, DevOps, and vendors to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, APIs, data flows, integrations, and non-functional requirements. - Translate business and technical requirements into automation scope, performance scenarios, test data needs, and quality risks. - Identify quality, performance, integration, and release risks early, and drive alignment on mitigation actions. - Support UAT/PAT and release readiness through defect insights, quality reporting, and go/no-go recommendations. (3) - Quality Improvement - Lead quality delivery across squads, vendors, and stakeholders with strong focus on automation, performance, and engineering efficiency. - Coach QE team members on automation practices, performance testing approach, test design, defect quality, and risk-based testing. - Drive continuous improvement in automation coverage, performance testing maturity, reporting quality, and defect prevention. - Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, performance findings review, and risk-based quality decision-making. - Promote a quality-first engineering culture and improve release confidence across delivery teams.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Finance, Banking, or a related field. - English proficiency in line with TCB requirements. - At least 8 years of experience in software testing or quality engineering, with practical experience in one or more areas such as manual, automation, API, web, mobile, data, or performance testing. - At least 1 year of experience as a test team lead or QA lead. - Highly proficient in least one language: Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent. - Proficient in SQL and test-data validation skills with Oracle, PostgreSQL, or another RDBMS, or one of the NoSQL DB. Experience with testing and relevant tools, such as: - API: Postman, Insomnia, or SoapUI; - UI automation: Selenium or Katalon; - Performance: JMeter, k6, or Gatling; - Frameworks: Karate + Playwright; - Good knowledge of Git and CI/CD test execution. - Experience organizing, implementing, and managing test activities. - Experience working and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. - Strong planning, work management, and execution skills. - Cloud (AWS, k8s,...) and AI knowledge, AI-assisted testing, and experience across both performance and automation are advantages. Candidates specializing in one area must demonstrate the foundation and commitment to perform in the other; manual-only candidates should bring senior-level or test-lead capability and be willing to build automation skills.

title: Middle - Senior QA Test Automation Engineer
jd_text:
Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks covering unit, integration, and end-to-end (E2E) testing scenarios. Build comprehensive test suites targeting API layers (REST, WebSockets), real-time data pipelines, and interactive frontend workflows. Integrate automated test suites directly into continuous delivery pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) for instant build validation and automated quality gates. Partner directly with software engineers and product managers during design phases to define clear acceptance criteria and platform testability requirements. Contribute to non-functional, load, stress, and conformance testing as the platform approaches go-live milestones to ensure high availability and sub-second latency. Track, document, and report on automated test coverage, regression defect trends, and root-cause analyses.

At least 3 years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering with a heavy focus on Test Automation. Experience building object-oriented or modular automated test frameworks from scratch using Python or TypeScript (e.g., PyTest, Playwright, Cypress, or custom API test harnesses). Strong experience testing backend service interfaces and real-time protocols, including RESTful APIs and WebSockets . Hands-on experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with containerized testing environments ( Docker ). Deep theoretical and practical mastery of testing methodologies: boundary value analysis, integration contracts, component mocking, and test pyramid strategies. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for collaborating with distributed engineering teams and writing clear technical documentation. Experience with high-throughput load and performance testing tools such as Locust , k6 , Gatling , or JMeter . Familiarity with testing event-driven or real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, WebSockets). Comfortable developing, debugging, and running test suites within Linux-based operating systems and container networks. Background in financial technology (Fintech), capital markets, trading platforms, or regulated software environments.

title: DevOps Engineer
jd_text:
Design scalable, secure, and maintainable application architecture for on-premises and/or public cloud environments. Define standard deployment patterns (VM-based, container-based, Kubernetes-based) and guide teams on best-fit approaches. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reusable templates to improve delivery speed, quality, and traceability. Install, configure, and harden middleware components (Nginx/Apache HTTPD/Tomcat), including TLS and routing best practices. Establish and promote architecture standards, security guidelines, and design principles (secrets handling, least privilege, secure defaults). Produce and maintain architecture documentation (diagrams, ADRs, runbooks, deployment guides). Collaborate with development, QA, product, and operations teams to ensure smooth releases and stable operations. Contribute to an AI Agent solution development project.

Proven ability to design application architecture and deliver modern applications in On-premises and/or Public Cloud environments. Working knowledge of CI/CD using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo CD/GitOps, or equivalent. Ability to install and configure at least one middleware stack (Nginx, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat). Capability to deploy applications on at least one of: on-premises servers, public cloud, containers, Kubernetes. Familiarity with artifact/container registries (e.g., Nexus Repository, Harbor, Docker Registry) including publishing, versioning, and access control. Understanding Linux fundamentals and basic networking (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS). Strong communication skills and effective collaboration with developers. Intermediate English communication skills (speaking).

title: NET Backend Developer
company: Công ty Cổ phần BiboMart TM
jd_text:
Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một .NET Backend Developer (Middle Level) tài năng và có tư duy logic tốt để tham gia vào đội ngũ phát triển các hệ thống, nền tảng phần mềm của công ty. Ở vị trí này, bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế, xây dựng và tối ưu hóa các dịch vụ backend cốt lõi, đảm bảo hệ thống vận hành mượt mà, có khả năng mở rộng tốt và bảo mật cao. Chi tiết:Phát triển sản phẩm: Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế kiến trúc chi tiết và lập trình các tính năng backend sử dụng nền tảng .NET/.NET Core.Xây dựng API: Thiết kế và phát triển các hệ thống RESTful API hoặc gRPC chất lượng cao, hiệu năng tốt để tích hợp với frontend (Web/Mobile) và các dịch vụ thứ ba.Tối ưu hệ thống: Tham gia tối ưu hóa hiệu năng ứng dụng, truy vấn cơ sở dữ liệu (SQL/NoSQL) và cấu trúc code để xử lý lượng dữ liệu lớn hoặc truy cập cao.Đảm bảo chất lượng: Viết Unit Test, Integration Test đảm bảo code chạy ổn định; tham gia rà soát code (Code Review) cho các thành viên trong team để nâng cao chất lượng sản phẩm.Vận hành & Giám sát: Phối hợp cùng đội ngũ DevOps để triển khai ứng dụng (CI/CD), cấu hình hệ thống giám sát log/metrics và xử lý nhanh các sự cố (troubleshooting) trên môi trường Production.Nghiên cứu công nghệ: Chủ động tìm hiểu, đề xuất các công nghệ hoặc giải pháp mới giúp cải tiến quy trình làm việc và hiệu suất hệ thống.

Nền tảng học vấn tốt từ công nghệ thông tin;Kinh nghiệm: Có từ 5 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc thực tế với ngôn ngữ C# và nền tảng .NET Core / .NET 5+.Kiến trúc & Tư duy: Nắm vững kiến trúc phần mềm (Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Microservices), các nguyên lý thiết kế SOLID, và các Design Patterns thông dụng.Cơ sở dữ liệu: Kinh nghiệm làm việc tốt với RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL hoặc MySQL) và Entity Framework Core. Biết tối ưu Index, Query Execution Plan là một lợi thế. Có hiểu biết về NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) là điểm cộng lớn.Công cụ & Môi trường: Thành thạo Git, hiểu quy trình Gitflow. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Docker/Containerization; Hiểu biết hoặc từng làm việc trong môi trường Linux/WSL là lợi thế.Giao tiếp & Tích hợp: Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Message Broker (RabbitMQ, Kafka) và các giải pháp xác thực (IdentityServer, OAuth2, JWT).Khả năng tư duy logic, giải quyết vấn đề tốt và tư duy hướng sản phẩm.Kỹ năng làm việc nhóm tốt, có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao và chủ động trong công việc.Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh tốt.

Nền tảng học vấn tốt từ công nghệ thông tin;Kinh nghiệm: Có từ 5 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc thực tế với ngôn ngữ C# và nền tảng .NET Core / .NET 5+.Kiến trúc & Tư duy: Nắm vững kiến trúc phần mềm (Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Microservices), các nguyên lý thiết kế SOLID, và các Design Patterns thông dụng.Cơ sở dữ liệu: Kinh nghiệm làm việc tốt với RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL hoặc MySQL) và Entity Framework Core. Biết tối ưu Index, Query Execution Plan là một lợi thế. Có hiểu biết về NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) là điểm cộng lớn.Công cụ & Môi trường: Thành thạo Git, hiểu quy trình Gitflow. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Docker/Containerization; Hiểu biết hoặc từng làm việc trong môi trường Linux/WSL là lợi thế.Giao tiếp & Tích hợp: Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Message Broker (RabbitMQ, Kafka) và các giải pháp xác thực (IdentityServer, OAuth2, JWT).Khả năng tư duy logic, giải quyết vấn đề tốt và tư duy hướng sản phẩm.Kỹ năng làm việc nhóm tốt, có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao và chủ động trong công việc.Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh tốt.

title: CyberSecurity/ Security Engineer
jd_text:
Công ty Cổ phần IVS thành lập vào năm 2002 tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. Là một Công ty phần mềm với 100% vốn đầu tư Nhật Bản. Trải qua hơn 20 năm phát triển, Công ty đã có sự phát triển vượt bậc về quy mô và chất lượng, đóng góp đáng kể cho ngành công nghiệp phần mềm tại Việt Nam. Hiện Công ty có gần 500 kỹ sư Việt Nam và Nhật Bản đang thực thi các dự án gia công phần mềm từ nước ngoài (Nhật Bản và UK) và các dự án tư vấn, hệ thống hóa cho các doanh nghiệp, nhà máy đang hoạt động tại Việt Nam. Để có sự phát triển bền vững, trải qua hơn 20 năm chúng tôi đã xây dựng văn hóa Công ty độc đáo, kết hợp nhuần nhuyễn giữa văn hóa Việt-Nhật và lấy nhân viên làm trung tâm. Các nhân viên IVS luôn được đào tạo và thể hiện năng lực của mình một cách CHUYÊN NGHIỆP nhất, với một tinh thần TRÁCH NHIỆM cao nhất và thái độ TÔN TRỌNG đối với công việc, khách hàng. Ngày nay, với sự ổn định trong quản lý, tinh xảo và bảo mật trong việc tạo giá trị sản phẩm. IVS là sự lựa chọn tin cậy của khách hàng, là môi trường đầy cạnh tranh, thu hút nhân tài CNTT ở Việt Nam. MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC Thực hiện các hoạt động kiểm thử, phân tích và đánh giá an toàn thông tin cho hệ thống/phần mềm. Phân tích các lỗ hổng bảo mật, rủi ro và các dấu hiệu bất thường liên quan đến hệ thống. Thực hiện security testing / vulnerability assessment / penetration testing theo yêu cầu dự án. Phối hợp với các team Development, QA và Infrastructure để xác định, xử lý và theo dõi các vấn đề bảo mật. Đánh giá kết quả kiểm thử, phân tích nguyên nhân và đề xuất phương án khắc phục. Hỗ trợ xây dựng tài liệu, báo cáo liên quan đến security testing và security analysis. Thực hiện các công việc khác liên quan đến Cyber Security / Information Security theo yêu cầu dự án.

Có kinh nghiệm làm việc thực tế trong lĩnh vực liên quan đến CyberSecurity / Software Security / Security Testing . Có ít nhất 01 trong các chứng chỉ sau: ISTQB CT-STE CompTIA CySA+ (Cybersecurity Analyst) CompTIA PenTest+ Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh, tiếng Nhật là 1 lợi thế. Có khả năng phân tích vấn đề và làm việc với các team kỹ thuật.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE, GCP, Kubernetes)
jd_text:
DatVietVAC Group Holdings is looking for a Senior SRE Engineer to lead the infrastructure architecture, platform reliability, and production operations of our Fan Commerce Platform . The platform operates across Google Cloud for computing and scaling and CMC Cloud for local data residency. You will be responsible for building a secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure capable of supporting high-traffic on-sale periods and major entertainment events while maintaining operational efficiency and infrastructure costs within the approved budget. Design and implement multi-environment infrastructure, including Production, Staging, and Development, using Google Cloud services such as GKE, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, and Pub/Sub. Design the hybrid-cloud architecture between Google Cloud and CMC Cloud, including private connectivity, VPN configuration, network segmentation, and data-flow separation. Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation tools that support engineering teams throughout the software development and release lifecycle. Establish a comprehensive observability platform covering metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting. Ensure that the infrastructure architecture supports scalability, maintainability, security, and local data-residency requirements. Define and manage Service Level Indicators, Service Level Objectives, and error budgets for core platform services. Take ownership of platform availability, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness. Lead capacity planning and load testing for high-traffic product launches, ticket or merchandise on-sales, and live events. Design autoscaling strategies, traffic-management mechanisms, and overload-protection measures. Participate in the 24/7 production on-call rotation and lead the response to high-severity incidents. Lead blameless postmortems, identify root causes, and ensure that corrective and preventive actions are completed. Develop incident-response procedures, operational runbooks, and disaster-recovery plans. Coach and mentor engineers in production operations, incident management, and reliability practices. Implement infrastructure security controls, including WAF, DDoS protection, and bot-management solutions using tools such as Cloudflare and Google Cloud Armor. Manage secrets, encryption, identity, and access controls across cloud environments. Establish backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery processes and conduct periodic recovery drills. Collaborate with relevant teams on penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance requirements. Ensure appropriate monitoring and audit logging for sensitive infrastructure and operational activities. Monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud infrastructure costs through rightsizing, committed-use discounts, storage lifecycle management, and egress optimization. Investigate performance bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve platform efficiency, scalability, and resilience. Provide infrastructure and reliability recommendations to the Project Lead and engineering teams. Evaluate and propose technologies that support the platform’s long-term architecture and business requirements.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. At least five years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, System Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or in a similar infrastructure role. At least one year of experience at an equivalent senior level or in a technical leadership role. Proven experience designing or operating production systems with high traffic or significant peak-load events, such as flash sales, on-sales, live events, entertainment platforms, or e-commerce platforms. Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure in a production environment. Production experience with Google Cloud Platform is mandatory. Advanced knowledge of networking and security concepts, including TCP/IP, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, DNS, gRPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN, and on-premises-to-cloud connectivity. Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, clustering, replication, failover, load balancing, and autoscaling. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, particularly Google Kubernetes Engine, and container technologies in production environments. Proficiency in infrastructure as code and automation tools, particularly Terraform and Ansible. Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent tools. Strong Linux administration skills, including experience with Ubuntu or CentOS. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud services; additional AWS or Azure experience is an advantage. Experience with performance testing, load testing, bottleneck analysis, capacity planning, and system optimization. Knowledge of API gateways, reverse proxies, ingress controllers, and service mesh architecture. Experience building observability systems using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts. Knowledge of SLI/SLO management, error budgets, incident response, postmortems, backup, and disaster recovery. Experience with infrastructure security solutions such as WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, secrets management, and access control. Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills. Ability to mentor engineers and guide teams through incident response and production operations. Calm, structured, and decisive when handling critical production incidents. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and risk-management skills. Data-driven approach to reliability, performance, capacity, and cost optimization. Strong attention to detail and a high sense of ownership. Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Basic English communication skills. Good ability to read and understand technical documentation in English. Willingness to participate in the production on-call rotation and support major on-sale periods or live events when required. Ability to work under pressure during critical releases, peak-traffic events, and production incidents.

title: Python / AI Developer (Middle & Above) - Infrastructure
jd_text:
The company is scaling up its intake and delivery of AI/Python application projects for clients. This role requires a Python/AI Developer with hands-on, real-world experience and strong ability to work independently — directly developing AI products/features, taking over and operating part of the infrastructure (Infra), and providing technical support to other team members when needed. Key Responsibilities Directly develop Python applications for AI/AI projects (chatbots, LLM integration, RAG, etc.). Integrate APIs from AI platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) into client systems. Independently design implementation-level architecture for assigned features/projects, only needing to align with the AI Technical Lead at a high level rather than requiring detailed day-to-day guidance. Takeover, operate, and be able to improve the existing infrastructure (Infra): server configuration, deployment, basic CI/CD, system monitoring. Ensure code quality and write clear technical documentation to reduce dependency on any single individual within the team. Provide technical support and code review for other team members when needed (especially for new Python/AI projects handled by others). Participate in direct technical discussions with clients when needed, including when the AI Technical Lead is unavailable. Reports to AI Technical Lead

Requirements At least 3–5 years of hands-on Python development experience in a real-world environment (production experience preferred, not only academic/training projects). Has independently delivered at least 1–2 real-world AI/GenAI/LLM projects (chatbot, RAG, AI model integration, etc.) — an important requirement, as this role works independently with limited close supervision. Able to independently design system architecture at a basic-to-intermediate level without needing step-by-step guidance. Experience with Infra/DevOps: Linux servers, Docker, CI/CD, production deployment. Highly self-driven, able to work independently, self-learn, and troubleshoot technical issues. Good communication skills, able to discuss technical topics directly with clients when needed. Good English proficiency for reading technical/requirement documentation and speaking Nice-to-have Prior experience as a Tech Lead or mentor for other developers. Experience working on outsourcing projects for Japanese clients. Experience with FastAPI/Django. Relevant AI/Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure AI, etc.). Japanese and English certifications (e.g., JLPT for Japanese, TOEIC/IELTS/TOEFL for English).
