title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (.Net, Angular)
jd_text:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full-stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET backend development and Angular frontend technologies. The ideal candidate should have solid experience building scalable enterprise applications, APIs, and modern web platforms, while also being familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and modern software development practices to improve productivity and innovation. This role requires strong technical ownership, system-thinking capabilities, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams in an Agile software development environment. Full-stack Software Development: Design, develop, maintain, and optimize full-stack web applications using .NET technologies and the Angular framework. Build scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications and APIs. Develop RESTful APIs, backend services, and frontend user interfaces. Ensure application performance, scalability, responsiveness, and security. Optimize database performance, application workflows, and system reliability. Backend Development (.NET): Develop backend systems using .NET Core/ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework, and RESTful APIs. Integrate applications with cloud platforms, mobile applications, and third-party services. Support microservices architecture and backend integrations when required. Frontend Development (Angular): Develop and maintain frontend applications using Angular. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create responsive, user-friendly interfaces. Ensure frontend performance optimization and cross-browser compatibility. Integrate the frontend application with the backend APIs and Services. AI-Assisted and DevOps Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to improve software development productivity and code quality. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical and production issues. Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and DevOps processes.

Minimum 7+ years of experience in full-stack software development. Strong experience with: .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, C#, Angular, SQL Server /MySQL / PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs Experience with: Entity Framework, Microservices architecture, Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, Docker or container technologies. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is preferred. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools: Claude code, Copilot,… Interest or experience in AI-powered applications or integrations is a plus

title: Nổi bậtChuyên Viên Dữ Liệu / Data Executive / Bắt Buộc Biết Tiếng Trung / Quận 7
jd_text:
Thu thập, xử lý và phân tích dữ liệu vận hành của công ty, đảm bảo tính chính xác và nguồn dữ liệu đáng tin cậy.Thiết kế và triển khai các báo cáo, dashboard phân tích dữ liệu phục vụ quản lý và ra quyết định.Theo dõi và kiểm soát quy trình dữ liệu, phát hiện vấn đề và đề xuất phương án tối ưu.Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để đảm bảo dự án phân tích dữ liệu hoàn thành đúng tiến độ và đạt độ chính xác cao.Phân tích biến động dữ liệu, xác định nguyên nhân và đánh giá tác động đến hoạt động kinh doanh.

title: Python Engineer
jd_text:
YOUR NEW ROLE CODE LEAP This role is for CODE LEAP's sister-company named AINAVIO . AINAVIO is a startup providing an all-in-one cloud solution for the e-commerce industry to gather, enrich, and distribute product content at scale. We are using AI and workflow automation to help our clients improve their product information management. As a spinoff of a consulting company, we already have a large e-commerce company as our client and are financially backed to get our product to the next level. We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer (Python) to join our team and help us develop further our deep learning models for image processing and classification. YOUR EXCITING TASKS Develop and maintain cloud-native backend services on AWS (e.g., ECS, SQS, SNS) Design and build scalable backend services using Python on a production running product Develop and maintain RESTful APIs following industry best practices Write clean, maintainable code with proper testing coverage (unit and integration tests) Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions Implement basic observability practices including logging and monitoring Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of production issues Stay up to date with emerging technologies, especially in AI/LLM tooling

4+ years of experience in backend software development using Python Strong Python skills with experience building production systems using FastAPI or similar frameworks Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, design patterns, testing discipline Experience with RESTful API design Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) Experience with automated testing using Pytest or similar Experience deploying or working with cloud-native applications (Azure preferred) Good problem-solving ability and willingness to take ownership Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams Proficiency in English communication Nice to have: C# experience Hands-on experience building LLM-powered features: prompting, tool calling, agent frameworks

title: Mid/Senior Fullstack Developer (ReactJS, NodeJS)
jd_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE: Are you a talented engineer with a passion to build beautiful, easy to use apps for users? Combine not only technical knowledge in Full-Stack JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, but also your business acumen in learning and understanding how your apps add value to users. Join us to continue expanding our unique B2B SaaS app portfolios with already over 35,000 customers. Responsibilities: Work on the design and development of apps from concept to production. Develop and maintain front-end components using modern JavaScript, TypeScript frameworks such as React.js or Angular. Implement server-side logic and APIs using Node.js, Express.js, NestJS or other back-end technologies. Design and optimize database schemas and queries using relational and/or NoSQL databases. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code adhering to coding standards and best practices. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to define and prioritize features. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends, and advocate for their adoption when appropriate.

Requirements: 5+ years of experience in full-stack web development, with a strong focus on both front-end and back-end technologies. Proficiency in front-end frameworks such as React.js, AngularJS. Proficiency in back-end technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, Nest.js. Experience with database systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Redis. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a track record of delivering scalable and reliable solutions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Intermediate English skills.

company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN PHẦN MỀM Y TẾ VIỆT NAM
jd_text:
Các ứng viên sau khi được tuyển chọn sẽ tham gia vào các dự án sau:Nghiên cứu và phát triển thêm các tính năng trong giải pháp phần mềm VIMES:-      Hệ thống phần mềm quản lý thông tin bệnh viện (HIS)-      Phần mềm bệnh án điện tử (EMR)-      Hệ thống phần mềm quản lý kết nối với máy xét nghiệm (LIS).-      Phần mềm quản lý lưu trữ và xử lý hình ảnh DICOM (PACS).-      Phần mềm quản lý tài chính kế toán, nhân sự tiền lương, tài sản trang thiết bị.Tham gia vào toàn bộ quá trình xây dựng hệ thống (nghiên cứu, khảo sát, phân tích thiết kế, code).Phát triển phân hệ bệnh án điện tử chạy trên các thiết bị smart.

Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTTThành thạo lập trình sử dụng các công nghệ: Javascript, Typescript, Flutter/ NodeJSƯu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm lập trình Flutter.Có kinh nghiệm trong việc lập trình với một trong hệ quản trị CSDL: Oracle, PostgreSQL, …Tham gia xây dựng, nâng cấp các API và tối ưu các tính năng hệ thống cho người dùng.Tìm hiểu và ứng dụng các công nghệ mới vào hệ thống nhằm nâng cao khả năng chịu tải của hệ thống.Tham gia nghiên cứu, phát triển các sản phẩm mới theo yêu cầu của khách hàng.Có khả năng phân tích và thiết kế phần mềm.Có tư duy sáng tạo, học hỏi và tiếp thu nhanh các công nghệ mới, chịu được áp lực công việc.Không hút thuốc.

title: Cloud DevOps Engineer (Good English)
jd_text:
As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy. We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability. As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, your tasks will include: Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions. Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., in Terraform. Automation and standardization of cloud infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI or Microsoft Graph API). Design and implementation of cloud governance solutions. Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects. Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience. Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work. Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work. Possess an analytical mindset, are motivated, and know how to work in a structured manner. Have good communication skills and Teamwork Good English communication

title: Product Manager - Fintech
jd_text:
We are looking for a Product Manager to own product development across the Finhay ecosystem. You will lead the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritization to launch and improvement. Securities products, including FHSC and securities features on the Finhay super app, are the current priority; the role covers all Finhay products as business needs evolve. Your day-to-day tasks will include: - Combine user research, behavioral data, and market and competitor analysis to identify customer needs and differentiation opportunities. - Shape product vision, goals, and roadmaps across Finhay, connecting near-term priorities with long-term business value. - Own and refine backlogs, balancing customer value, business impact, technical debt, reliability, and dependencies with Design and Engineering. - Define and validate solutions, requirements, and testable acceptance criteria, including edge cases and failure scenarios. - Use AI in research, requirements drafting, and backlog refinement, verifying outputs and remaining accountable for quality. - Work with business, operations, risk, and compliance teams to address operational and regulatory requirements before launch. - Coordinate delivery, acceptance testing, and launches. Manage risks and cross-team dependencies, adjust plans, and monitor product quality. - Define success metrics and tracking, analyze results, and run experiments to improve adoption, conversion, and retention. - Align stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs, share product practices, and support less experienced colleagues through feedback and review.

- 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or an equivalent digital product role, with direct experience developing securities products or trading platforms. - Solid knowledge of securities workflows, including account opening, funding, order types and lifecycle, buying power, balances, settlement, fees, and portfolio tracking. - Proven ability to take a product or feature from discovery to launch, explain your decisions, and demonstrate measurable results. - Broad product thinking: connect customer journeys across services, translate business goals into product direction, and balance short-term priorities with long-term value. - Strong user research, market analysis, and analytical skills to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and evaluate product performance. - Ability to translate complex financial workflows into clear requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria, including edge cases. - Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs, balancing customer value, business impact, technical debt, and delivery dependencies. - Working understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data flows to evaluate feasibility and discuss technical trade-offs with Engineering. - Practical experience using AI in product workflows, with sound judgment in verifying outputs and protecting sensitive information. - Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve conflicting priorities and take ownership of outcomes. - Ability to learn new financial domains and adapt as product priorities evolve. - Experience with super apps, other investment products, core securities integrations, margin trading, SQL, or product analytics tools is a plus.

title: Data & Business Intelligence Professional / Senior Prof
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN CHỨNG KHOÁN KAFI
jd_text:
Job Overview We are seeking a skilled Data & Business Intelligence Professional to join our team. In this role, you will transform data into meaningful insights through compelling data storytelling and intuitive visualizations, with a strong focus on generating actionable insights that directly support business decision-making. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand key problems, design analytics solutions, and deliver impactful dashboards that support data-driven decision-making. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, define key metrics, and translate business questions into analytical solutions. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, root causes, and actionable insights that directly influence business decisions. Design and develop dashboards with clear business narratives, focusing on driving understanding and decision-making (not just reporting). Communicate insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business initiatives, performance tracking, and strategic planning. Work closely with Data Engineers to understand data pipelines, ensure data quality, and propose data structure improvements for analytics use cases. Contribute to the design of analytical data models / data marts to enable scalable and reliable analytics.

Must-Have: Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle). Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Strong data visualization and data storytelling skills, with proven ability to generate actionable insights that support business decision-making. Ability to connect data insights to business context, quantify impact, and provide clear recommendations for decision-making. Good foundational understanding of data pipelines and data transformation to effectively collaborate with Data Engineers on data preparation. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Honesty, dignity, and responsibility. Precision, passion, open-mindedness, and quick self-learning skills in big data, as well as enthusiasm for solving business problems. For Senior-level candidates, additional expectations include experience in hypothesis-driven analysis, predictive or forecasting models, scenario modelling, leading end-to-end analytics projects, and delivering strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders. Nice-to-Have: Background or experience of financial services, securities, or fintech. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS). Experience with Python, R, or similar programming languages. Exposure to or ongoing learning in Data Science, Data Modelling, or Data Governance concepts.

title: SENIOR TESTER (QC Lead)
jd_text:
We are seeking a practical, experienced Senior Tester to serve as our primary quality gatekeeper and be ready to take responsibility for leading the test team soon. In this role, your core mission is to deeply understand project specifications, ensure the development team's code strictly matches business requirements, and safeguard release deadlines: - Requirement Clarification: Thoroughly review specifications, communicate with the project team to identify ambiguities, missing logic, and edge cases. - Quality Control: Build focused test plans and test scenarios directly mapped to business requirements and acceptance criteria; Work side-by-side with developers daily: log clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes promptly to unblock progress. - Timeline & Risk Management: Align test schedules with sprint milestones to prevent testing bottlenecks at the end of cycles; Identify and raise early red flags on schedule risks For this position, you may work across multiple projects at the same time and support team members in meeting their project requirements and delivery timelines.

- Experience: Years of experience in Software QA /QC, including at least 1 year as a Test Lead or Senior QA responsible for project output. - English: Strong English communication skills to align technical requirements and drive day-to-day communication between the Australian team and developers. - Requirement Analysis: Exceptional ability to translate complex business logic into actionable, edge-case-proof test cases. - Timeline Discipline: Proven capability in managing test priorities against tight release deadlines without sacrificing core quality.

jd_text:
- Dẫn dắt và triển khai các dự án hệ thống của GHTK, với traffic cao, xử lý dữ liệu đơn hàng lớn theo thời gian thực.- Xây dựng và phát triển các sản phẩm công nghệ phục vụ khách hàng, người dùng cuối, giúp nâng cao trải nghiệm dịch vụ.- Thiết kế và tối ưu hiệu suất hệ thống, đảm bảo khả năng mở rộng và ổn định.- Tối ưu hiệu năng hệ thống, giảm độ trễ, tăng khả năng chịu tải, đảm bảo hoạt động ổn định ngay cả trong thời gian cao điểm.- Nghiên cứu, áp dụng các công nghệ mới, đề xuất giải pháp cải tiến hệ thống.- Hướng dẫn, đào tạo và hỗ trợ đội ngũ kỹ sư phần mềm, đảm bảo chất lượng code và định hướng kỹ thuật chung cho team.THỜI GIAN, ĐỊA ĐIỂM LÀM VIỆC- Thời gian làm việc: 8h30’ - 18h00’, từ thứ 2 đến hết sáng thứ 7.- Địa điểm: Trụ sở GHTK Building, số 8 Phạm Hùng, Phường Từ Liêm, Hà Nội.

1. Bằng cấp & nền tảng- Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin hoặc các ngành liên quan.- Ưu tiên ứng viên tốt nghiệp từ các trường: ĐH Bách Khoa, ĐH Công nghệ - ĐHQGHN, FPT, Bưu Chính Viễn Thông, ĐH Công Nghiệp,…2. Kinh nghiệm & kỹ năng- Tối thiểu5 năm kinh nghiệmphát triển phần mềm với Java và hệ thống phân tán.- Thành thạo các công nghệ Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis, Cassandra.- Kinh nghiệm làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ (MySQL), tối ưu truy vấn, indexing, sharding.- Thành thạo microservices architecture, hệ thống event-driven và real-time processing.- Hiểu sâu về cấu trúc dữ liệu, thuật toán và khả năng tối ưu mã nguồn.- Có kinh nghiệm với Linux server và CI/CD pipelines là một lợi thế.- Có khả năng tìm hiểu công nghệ mới và xử lý sự cố hệ thống.3. Tố chất & tư duy- Tư duy logic tốt, khả năng giải quyết vấn đề nhanh và hiệu quả.- Tinh thần trách nhiệm cao, chủ động trong công việc, sẵn sàng nhận thử thách.- Kỹ năng làm việc nhóm, giao tiếp và mentoring tốt.- Đam mê công nghệ, không ngừng học hỏi để nâng cao năng lực.

title: Senior IT Business Analyst
company: NGÂN HÀNG THƯƠNG MẠI TNHH MTV KỶ NGUYÊN THỊNH VƯỢNG (GPBANK)
jd_text:
Vai trò phân tích và chuyển hóa yêu cầu nghiệp vụ quản trị nội bộ (Tài chính, nhân sự , pháp chế, Rủi ro, vận hành…) thành giải pháp công nghệ phù hợp, đồng thời theo sát toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển phần mềm để đảm bảo tính đúng đắn và khả thi. Vai trò này giúp ngân hàng vận hành hiệu quả, tuân thủ quy định, kiểm soát rủi ro và xây dựng nền tảng hệ thống bền vững phục vụ mục tiêu quản trị và phát triển lâu dài.

1. Bằng cấp: Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên, chuyên ngành: Công nghệ Thông tin, Hệ thống Thông tin Quản lý, Khoa học Máy tính, Toán – Tin, Tài chính – Ngân hàng, Kế toán – Kiểm toán hoặc các ngành liên quan. Ưu tiên: Có chứng chỉ nghiệp vụ hoặc công nghệ liên quan: BA/IT Business Analysis: CBAP, CCBA (IIBA) hoặc tương đương. Quản lý dự án: PMP, Agile/Scrum Product Owner/Business Analyst. Ngân hàng – Tài chính: chứng chỉ AML/KYC, Risk Management, Compliance là một lợi thế. Có kiến thức nền tảng vững chắc về quy trình vận hành ngân hàng backoffice (HR, Risk, Compliance, AML, Ops Có chứng chỉ nghiệp vụ hoặc công nghệ liên quan: BA/IT Business Analysis: CBAP, CCBA (IIBA) hoặc tương đương. Quản lý dự án: PMP, Agile/Scrum Product Owner/Business Analyst. Ngân hàng – Tài chính: chứng chỉ AML/KYC, Risk Management, Compliance là một lợi thế. BA/IT Business Analysis: CBAP, CCBA (IIBA) hoặc tương đương. Quản lý dự án: PMP, Agile/Scrum Product Owner/Business Analyst. Ngân hàng – Tài chính: chứng chỉ AML/KYC, Risk Management, Compliance là một lợi thế. Có kiến thức nền tảng vững chắc về quy trình vận hành ngân hàng backoffice (HR, Risk, Compliance, AML, Ops 2. Kiến thức/ Chuyên môn cần có Quy trình nghiệp vụ ngân hàng backoffice: Hiểu biết vững về các quy trình quản trị nội bộ: quản lý nhân sự (HR), quản lý rủi ro (Risk), AML/KYC, Compliance, công nghệ vận hành (Ops). Nắm rõ yêu cầu tuân thủ pháp lý, quy định của NHNN, chuẩn mực AML, quản trị rủi ro và kiểm toán nội bộ. Phân tích nghiệp vụ & giải pháp CNTT: Nắm vững các phương pháp phân tích nghiệp vụ: use case, user story, BPMN, process mapping. Kỹ năng thu thập, phân tích, xác thực và quản lý yêu cầu (elicitation & requirement management). Kiến thức về chuẩn tài liệu: BRD, FRD, URS, Solution Design. Kiến thức về hệ thống CNTT ngân hàng: Kiến thức cơ bản về core banking, các hệ thống hỗ trợ vận hành (HRM, ERP, Risk/AML systems). Hiểu về kiến trúc ứng dụng, dữ liệu, tích hợp API, kết nối với các hệ thống khác trong ngân hàng. Quản lý vòng đời dự án & phát triển phần mềm: Am hiểu phương pháp quản lý dự án (Waterfall, Agile/Scrum, Hybrid). Hiểu quy trình kiểm thử phần mềm (UAT, SIT, Performance test) và đảm bảo chất lượng. Kiến thức cơ bản về IT-Security, kiểm soát thay đổi, quản trị rủi ro CNTT. Công cụ & kỹ thuật hỗ trợ: Thành thạo công cụ phân tích & mô hình hóa: MS Visio, Bizagi, Draw.io hoặc tương đương. Kỹ năng sử dụng Jira, Confluence, MS Project hoặc các công cụ quản lý backlog và dự án. Kỹ năng làm việc với dữ liệu (SQL cơ bản, Excel nâng cao, BI/reporting tool là lợi thế) 3. Các kinh nghiệm liên quan: Kinh nghiệm phân tích nghiệp vụ CNTT: Tối thiểu 3–5 năm kinh nghiệm trong vai trò Business Analyst/IT Analyst trong lĩnh vực tài chính – ngân hàng hoặc các ngành có quy trình vận hành phức tạp. Có kinh nghiệm tham gia dự án triển khai hệ thống ngân hàng backoffice (HRM, Risk, Compliance, AML, ERP nội bộ). Kinh nghiệm dự án & phát triển phần mềm: Đã trực tiếp tham gia nhiều giai đoạn vòng đời dự án: từ thu thập yêu cầu, phân tích, thiết kế giải pháp, kiểm thử đến triển khai và hỗ trợ vận hành. Hiểu rõ cả hai phương pháp quản lý dự án Waterfall và Agile/Scrum ; có kinh nghiệm làm việc với backlog, user stories, sprint planning. Kinh nghiệm phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan: Từng làm việc trực tiếp với nhiều phòng ban backoffice (HR, Risk, Ops, Compliance, IT-Security) và vendor/đối tác triển khai hệ thống. Có kinh nghiệm xử lý các tình huống xung đột yêu cầu, thống nhất ưu tiên giữa các bên. Kinh nghiệm kiểm thử & nghiệm thu: Trực tiếp tham gia xây dựng test case, hỗ trợ UAT, SIT và nghiệm thu hệ thống. Có kinh nghiệm trong việc phát hiện, phân loại và theo dõi lỗi đến khi khắc phục.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack, Golang/JavaScript)
jd_text:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can move fluidly across the stack — frontend and backend — and who uses AI-native tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and similar) as part of how they build, not as an afterthought. You don't need prior end-to-end full-stack experience to apply. If your background is primarily frontend or primarily backend but you're genuinely interested in growing into a fullstack role, we want to hear from you. What matters more than your past title is your mindset and your ability to learn fast, especially with AI as a force multiplier. You will not just "convert Figma to code" or "code tickets." Your core challenges will include: Craft delightful, intuitive interfaces that anticipate user needs across our product suite — email, forms, checkout, and workflow automation, and many more in the future. Build and operate high-scale backend systems handling billions of annual events, solving real challenges in speed, data processing, and stability. Build AI-powered features — smarter writing assistance, auto-generated designs, intelligent workflows, and new AI products built from the ground up. Design strong APIs and integrations with partners like Shopify, Zapier, and WooCommerce. Own your work end-to-end — from understanding why a request exists, to deciding what should be built, to shipping how it's built in production. Work directly with Product Managers and Designers to decide how features should work — not just how they're implemented.

We hire for mindset first, technology second. Whichever side of the stack you're strongest in today, we expect depth there and genuine curiosity about the other side: Frontend Deep skills in TypeScript and React (Hooks, Context); you understand how React works under the hood (re-rendering, virtual DOM). Comfortable with modern build tools (Vite, Turbo) and monorepos. Strong foundation in performance optimization and code-splitting. Backend Strong computer science foundation and problem-solving skills. Experience with SOA architecture (Golang/Node.js preferred), MongoDB/PostgreSQL, and AWS services. Comfortable designing systems that stay fast even as traffic scales 10x. AI-Augmented Development You use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) as a genuine engineering practice — not just autocomplete. You know what to delegate to AI and what requires your own judgment, and you remain fully responsible for the code you ship. This is what we screen for most carefully: Why & What before How. When you receive a request, your first instinct is to ask why it needs to exist and what problem it actually solves — not to jump straight into implementation. You build for the user, not just the ticket. Whether it's an external customer or an internal ops teammate, you think about whether what you're building actually helps them, and you're not satisfied shipping something no one asked for or no one uses. You see the big picture. You think about downstream impact, maintainability, and business consequences — not just your feature or module in isolation. You've built things because you saw they were needed — not only because you were assigned to. Personal projects, internal tools, or improvements you drove yourself are all strong signals here. High responsibility. You work independently. You don't wait for detailed instructions — you talk to the PM, understand the requirement, and deliver the solution. Ships to production. You take things all the way, not just to prototype or demo stage. Clear async communication. You can explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders clearly and respectfully, and you document assumptions rather than blocking on answers. Teamwork. You believe in code reviews and knowledge sharing, and you help the team get better every day. Experience shipping AI or conversational UI features that improved real user outcomes. Experience with SaaS-specific problems (fair usage, noisy neighbor), large-scale databases (sharding, partitioning, no-downtime migration), Martech, or Fintech domains. Experience building internal tools for non-technical teams (ops, CS, support). Experience leading an engineering team or mentoring other engineers.

title: Data Engineer (Java, Python, SQL)
company: CÔNG TY TNHH NEXLAB IT SOLUTIONS
jd_text:
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines that power real-time processing and analytics. You will work on high-throughput data systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and maintainability across the data lifecycle — from ingestion to storage and search. This role requires strong experience in distributed systems, stream processing, and cloud-native data infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Design and implement real-time and batch data pipelines Build and maintain scalable streaming systems Develop and optimize stream processing jobs Ensure reliable ingestion from multiple internal and external data sources Design event schemas and data contracts Implement data validation, transformation, and enrichment logic Optimize storage layouts and lifecycle management strategies Improve system observability (metrics, logging, alerting) Troubleshoot and resolve performance bottlenecks in distributed systems Implement retry, dead-letter, and replay mechanisms Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance Collaborate with Backend, DevOps, and Security teams

Must-Have Proficiency in Java, Python, and SQL; strong software engineering fundamentals Experience with distributed messaging systems (e.g., Apache Kafka) and stream processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Flink) Knowledge of event-time processing, windowing, state management, and handling out-of-order events Experience with cloud storage/data lakes, relational databases, and search/indexing engines (e.g., OpenSearch / Elasticsearch) Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), IaC (Terraform), CI/CD, and containerization (Docker) Strong problem-solving skills and ability to design scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines Nice-to-Have Experience with workflow orchestration platforms Experience in security, log processing, or observability domains Schema management tools (Avro, Protobuf, Schema Registry) Data lake table formats (Iceberg, Hudi, Delta Lake) Experience with distributed query engines (Athena, Trino, Presto) Multi-tenant system design Cost optimization in large-scale cloud environments Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and debugging skills in distributed systems Ownership mindset with attention to reliability and quality Clear communication and documentation skills Ability to work cross-functionally Comfort working in fast-paced environments Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 7+ years of experience in data engineering or distributed systems Strong fundamentals in system design and scalability Proven experience operating production-grade data platforms Ability to balance performance, cost, and reliability

jd_text:
About Us We are a cybersecurity company building AI-native security platforms that span both offensive and defensive operations: Offensive Platform — An autonomous security platform that uses agentic AI to continuously penetration-test APIs, web applications, and cloud infrastructure. It validates vulnerabilities, chains attack paths, and generates audit-ready reports — all with human-in-the-loop safety controls. Defensive Platform — A role-based AI SOC platform where specialized agents (SOC Manager, Analyst, Incident Response, Threat Hunter) work as a coordinated crew to triage alerts, investigate incidents, hunt threats, and manage Detection-as-Code — at machine speed, under human oversight. We are not building wrappers around ChatGPT. We are building autonomous, multi-step AI agent systems that reason, plan, use tools, and take real-world action in high-stakes security environments. The Role As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and ship the autonomous AI agent systems at the core of our products. Depending on your background and interest, you'll work on one or both of the following: Offensive Security Agents: You'll build the agent brain that plans multi-step attack strategies, generates auditable configuration files, orchestrates security tool execution (Nmap, Nuclei, Nessus, custom exploits), validates discovered vulnerabilities, and chains minor findings into critical attack paths — all within a human-in-the-loop approval framework. Defensive Security Agents: You'll build the specialized SOC agents that autonomously triage and correlate alerts, enrich events with contextual data, summarize investigations, propose detection rules, execute threat hunting queries, and recommend incident response actions — while keeping analysts in control of final decisions. What You'll Do Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that handle multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and planning in production security workflows Build reliable agent loops with proper error handling, retry logic, guardrails, and human-inthe-loop approval gates for high-risk actions Develop dynamic tool-calling pipelines where agents select, configure, and orchestrate external security tools based on contextual analysis Engineer prompt chains and agent reasoning strategies across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude) with model-agnostic abstractions Build and maintain the context layer that gives agents awareness of users, assets, past incidents, typical behavior, and environmental state Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety — especially for high-stakes actions like exploit execution or incident response recommendations Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic Optimize for latency, cost, and token efficiency in production agent workloads Support on-premise deployments using self-hosted open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama) for air-gapped enterprise customers

Must Have 4+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python 1+ year of hands-on experience building LLM-powered agent systems — not chatbots, but agents that reason, plan, use tools, and take multi-step actions Deep working knowledge of at least one agentic framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent Experience with tool-calling / function-calling patterns, including dynamic tool selection and chaining Solid understanding of prompt engineering for complex reasoning tasks — chain-of-thought, ReAct, plan-and-execute patterns Experience integrating with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and managing model-agnostic abstractions Ability to build robust, production-grade systems — not just prototypes. You think about failure modes, retries, timeouts, guardrails, and observability Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, async programming, and API design Strong Plus Background in cybersecurity — offensive (pentesting, vulnerability assessment, red teaming) or defensive (SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, incident response) Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK framework, Sigma rules, or detection-as-code practices Experience deploying and fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) for onpremise or air-gapped environments Knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j) for modeling attack paths or entity relationships Experience building multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate, delegate, and share context Familiarity with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems Mindset You're excited about building AI systems that take real action in the world, not just generate text You have a strong security intuition — you think about what can go wrong, what an adversary would do, and where guardrails are needed You're comfortable with ambiguity and can translate vague domain requirements into concrete agent behaviors You care about reliability over cleverness — a working agent that handles edge cases beats a flashy demo

jd_text:
Unity Developer (WebGL) Position: Unity Developer (WebGL) Responsibilities Develop and maintain a Unity WebGL application for desktop and mobile browsers. Build interactive 3D features such as: Camera navigation Object selection and highlighting Measurement tools Section view / clipping Timeline playback Annotation and markup Material and object visibility control Optimize WebGL performance, loading time, and memory usage. Implement Addressables or asset streaming solutions for large 3D projects. Integrate REST APIs with backend services. Work with cloud storage (AWS S3 or similar) for asset delivery. Collaborate with UI/UX designers and backend developers. Debug and resolve browser-specific issues across Chrome, Edge, Safari, and mobile devices. Maintain clean, reusable, and scalable code.

title: Engineering Team Lead (AI-native, Java, English)
jd_text:
HRS As a Company HRS is a global technology company transforming how businesses manage lodging and meetings through AI-driven, data-centric solutions. With more than 50 years of experience, HRS serves global enterprises, hotel partners, and business travelers through Lodging-as-a-Service, Meeting-as-a-Service, and Workforce-as-a-Service offerings. Business Unit The Search & Book unit at HRS plays a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions through HRS Connect, the company's flagship product within the expansive global corporate travel management market. HRS Connect specifically targets the rapidly growing and significantly underserved segments of corporate lodging, meetings, groups, and long stays. The unit develops, enhances, and maintains complex technology solutions that seamlessly integrate hotel distribution systems, Property Management Systems (PMS), Online Travel Agencies (OTA), and Hotel Chain systems into the HRS Connect platform. Leveraging robust connectivity, innovative technology, and data-driven insights, the unit ensures seamless connectivity, optimized travel spend, enhanced traveler experiences, and high-performance booking solutions for global enterprise customers. Savings Engine is the transaction and rate intelligence backbone of Connect. Its performance directly affects booking success, rate competitiveness, customer savings, confirmation reliability, and the quality of the end-to-end traveler booking experience. Position We are looking for an Engineering Team Lead in HCM City, Vietnam. This is a hands-on leadership role for a business-critical product area. The ETL will lead Team Savings Engine, own engineering delivery for the core booking infrastructure, grow the team, and turn Savings Engine into an AI-native engineering team from day one. This is not a pure people-management role. You will lead engineers, own delivery, stay close to architecture, and set the operating model for how the team uses AI in daily engineering work: Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted code review, test generation, regression analysis, documentation, and production diagnosis. Challenges Own engineering delivery for the Booking Engine, Offer Engine, Reservation Engine and related rate-management services. Lead the team-wide AI-native operating model: Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted code review, agentic SDLC, and measurable cycle-time improvement. title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Java + React)
jd_text:
Game Publishing Platform (GPP) builds and runs the core systems behind all VNGGames products - payment & billing, account & passport, webshop, and the storefronts that players use every day. Our systems serve millions of players in Southeast Asia and other international markets. We are an AI-First team. We build large backend systems and web applications, and we also use AI tools every day to code faster, improve code quality, and automate repetitive work. We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer who is strong in both backend (Java/Spring) and frontend (Next.js/React), and who can take full ownership of a feature from the database to the user interface. What you will do Design, build, and run features end-to-end, from backend services and data models to the user interface, on systems used by millions of people. Develop and maintain large-scale Payment/Billing and Platform services. Make sure they are highly available, secure, and fast under heavy load. Build and improve our storefront on Next.js. It supports many regions and languages and has clear performance and conversion targets. Help shape the system architecture on both backend and frontend, and make sure the team follows the agreed design principles. Lead and take part in Code Review. Help raise the team's standard for automated testing. Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT…) for coding, review, refactoring, unit testing, and automation. Help the team turn AI usage into a clear, repeatable process. Mentor junior engineers and help them grow. Work closely with Product, QC, Design, and Operations to ship features with a smooth user experience.

Experience At least 5 years of software development experience, with at least 3 years using Java in production. At least 2 years of production experience with React and TypeScript. Next.js experience is a strong plus. Fundamentals Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and databases. Able to analyze a system for performance, concurrency, and failure cases. Technical Skill: Strong in Java Core and Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security). Production experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript Experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization), Redis, and MongoDB. Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ. Clear understanding of Microservices vs. Modular Monolith and their trade-offs. Experience designing REST APIs, managing versions, and keeping backward compatibility. Cloud & DevOps Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools. Used to monitoring systems with tracing, metrics, and logs (Sentry, OpenTelemetry/Prometheus or similar). Skills and mindset Solve problems well under pressure, especially on systems that handle payments and revenue. Actively look for better solutions and new technology, especially AI. Communicate clearly and work well with other teams.

title: Team Lead - Senior Backend Dev Backbase
jd_text:
Design, develop, and optimize backend services, integration components, and APIs on or around the Backbase platform, ensuring security, scalability, maintainability, and delivery quality. Translate business requirements into technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, integration flows, estimates, and implementation plans. Integrate Backbase with Core Banking, Payment Hub, CRM, eKYC, LOS, IAM, Data Platform, and other banking systems through REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, message queues, or middleware. Participate in architecture, code, and design reviews; enforce coding standards and ensure quality through unit tests, integration tests, static analysis, and defect prevention. Diagnose and resolve integration, performance, security, and production issues; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive actions. Collaborate with DevOps, QA, BA, Solution Architect, and client teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, observability, and deployment reliability. Produce and maintain technical artifacts, including solution design, API specifications, sequence diagrams, data-mapping documents, deployment guides, and operational runbooks. For Tech Lead level: lead a backend workstream of 4–8 engineers; plan and prioritize work, review critical pull requests, manage technical risks, mentor team members, and deliver agreed milestones.

5 years of proven experience in backend software development, including enterprise-scale systems and complex system integrations. Demonstrable experience delivering, customizing, upgrading, or integrating Backbase in at least one digital-banking project; familiarity with Backbase Engagement Banking Platform, Digital Banking Services, or Backbase Integration is highly valued. Strong hands-on experience with Java 11+, Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful API design, JSON/XML, Maven or Gradle. Solid understanding of microservices architecture, API lifecycle management, versioning, authentication and authorization, idempotency, error handling, and observability. Experience integrating enterprise systems using REST/SOAP, Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies. Strong database experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including SQL analysis, query optimization, and data modeling for integration workloads. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, and CI/CD practices. Backbase certification is required Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English; able to read and write technical documentation and participate effectively in technical discussions with international stakeholders.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Mobile App/ Data Platform)
jd_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a key driver in designing, scaling, and operating the data backbone across our entire Mobile Apps & Games ecosystem. You will be responsible for transforming tens of millions of raw event logs (in-app events, MMP tracking, ad network revenues) into robust Data Warehouse models, high-performance feature pipelines for ML/AI models (LTV forecasting, anomaly detection), and internal self-service analytics platforms for Product & Growth Squads. Build and operate end-to-end ELT/ETL data pipelines (batch & near-realtime) to ingest data from MMPs (Adjust, Qonversion), Ad Networks (Google Ads, AdMob, AppLovin, Mintegral, Apple Search Ads,...), and in-app event tracking into the Data Warehouse. Design schema architectures (Star/Snowflake), optimize complex analytical queries, partitioning, clustering, and storage costs on Google BigQuery and modern columnar databases. Build, scale, and maintain workflow orchestrations using Apache Airflow, Celery, Redis, and Docker on Cloud environments (GCP/Compute Engine). Develop custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent tools, and data APIs to connect LLMs and AI IDEs directly with data warehouses, documentation vaults, and internal systems. Construct reliable feature stores and datasets for Machine Learning/AI initiatives (LTV forecasting, payback modeling, anomaly detection) and assist in model serving pipelines. Implement data observability, automated monitoring, and data quality checks; develop internal data tools and self-service dashboards using Streamlit and Metabase/Looker Studio. Establish engineering best practices, data modeling standards, and comprehensive documentation (Data Dictionaries, Architecture Blueprints).

3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Strong proficiency in Python for high-performance data processing and advanced SQL (performance tuning, window functions, complex transformations). Solid experience with Google BigQuery (or modern columnar stores like ClickHouse, Snowflake, Redshift), including query optimization and cost management. Practical experience with Apache Airflow, Celery/Redis, Docker/containerization, CI/CD workflows, and Cloud platforms (GCP preferred). AI-First & Vibe Coding Mindset: Daily hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and AI IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, Antigravity, etc.) to rapidly prototype, build, and ship production-grade code at high velocity. Hands-on experience or strong interest in building/integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom tools, and AI workflows for data engineering tasks. Strong ownership, problem-solving abilities, clear communication, and effective collaboration with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Leadership. Nice to have: Domain knowledge in Mobile Apps, Games, or Digital Advertising / AdTech (MMP attribution, Ad Network APIs, eCPM, ROAS, LTV). Experience building internal web tools or BI applications using Streamlit. Familiarity with ML lifecycles, BigQuery ML, or LLM serving infrastructure and token monitoring. Experience with workflow automation APIs (Google Apps Script, Slack webhooks, third-party integrations).

title: Business Analyst – Lumin Team (2-3 years, Up to $1800)
jd_text:
Designveloper are looking for a proactive and analytical Business Analyst to join the Lumin team. You will work closely with Product Owners, Designers, Engineers, QA, and other stakeholders to understand business and user needs, define clear product requirements, and support the team throughout delivery. This role requires strong analytical thinking, ownership, communication skills, and the ability to use data and AI effectively. Key responsibilities Understand business objectives, user problems, and product requirements. Translate requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and functional requirements. Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, risks, and impacts on existing user journeys. Work with Product Owners and Designers to clarify scope, user flows, and expected product behavior. Support Engineers and QA by clarifying requirements during development and testing. Review delivered features to ensure they meet requirements and business objectives. Analyze data to investigate problems, validate assumptions, and support product decisions. Proactively follow up on open questions, blockers, and dependencies. Use AI tools to improve requirement analysis, research, documentation, and problem-solving.

2–3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar product role. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems. Ability to write clear, logical, and testable product requirements. Good data analysis skills and ability to turn data into meaningful insights. Proactive, responsible, and able to take ownership of work with minimal supervision. Strong collaboration skills across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, and stakeholders. Practical experience using AI tools for analysis, research, documentation, and productivity. Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs. Experience with mobile or web products is a strong advantage.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jd_text:
Overview We are looking for a Senior Cloud Operations Engineer (CloudOps) with strong expertise in AWS cloud operations, cloud security, and infrastructure automation. This role is critical in ensuring our cloud platforms are secure, scalable, cost-efficient, and highly available. You will take ownership of cloud optimization, security posture management, and automation using Infrastructure as Code and scripting. **Key Responsibilities Cloud Operations & Reliability Operate and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex cloud infrastructure issues across multiple environments Implement best practices for cloud operations, resilience, and disaster recovery Collaborate with application teams to improve operational excellence for serverless workloads Cloud Security Design, implement, and maintain secure cloud architectures following security best practices Identify, analyze, and remediate security issues and vulnerability findings from security tools and audits Work closely with security teams to improve cloud security posture and compliance Implement IAM policies, network security controls, encryption, and logging/monitoring Infrastructure as Code & Automation Design and manage infrastructure using Terraform and IaC best practices Build and maintain automation scripts and tools using Python (or similar scripting languages) Automate cloud operations, security controls, monitoring, and remediation workflows Cloud Optimization Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives (FinOps mindset) Optimize performance, scalability, and resource utilization across AWS services Provide recommendations and implement improvements to reduce waste and improve efficiency

5+ years of experience in Cloud Operations Engineer (CloudOps) position Strong hands-on experience with AWS services , including: + EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AppSync, API Gateway + Serverless services such as AWS Lambda Solid understanding of networking concepts (VPC design, routing, security groups, NACLs, VPNs) Proven experience in cloud security, vulnerability management, and incident remediation Hands-on experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Strong automation skills using Python (or equivalent scripting language) Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions Ability to troubleshoot complex cloud and security issues under pressure Nice to have Experience with cloud security tools (e.g., GuardDuty, Wiz, etc) Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with container platforms (EKS, ECS, Docker) AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Security Specialty) Soft skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to work independently and take ownership of cloud environments Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams Security-first mindset with a passion for automation and continuous improvement

title: Lead Fullstack Developer (.NET & Angular)
jd_text:
RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop professional, sustainable, and secure applications using cutting-edge technologies to enhance efficiency and quality. Participate in both Back-end (.NET, MS SQL) and Front-end (Angular, Blazor) development. Ensure compliance with functional and non-functional requirements, including security, performance, scalability, and usability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. Provide technical insights and propose cost-effective solutions to business requirements. Mentor junior developers and share best practices for coding standards and architecture.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. At least 4 - 9 years of hands-on experience in software development. Strong proficiency in MS SQL and relational database design. Expertise in Microsoft technologies: ASP.NET Core, .NET 5/6, MVC Framework, REST API development, background services. Front-end development experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML 5, CSS 3 and Blazor. Familiarity with Azure Cloud services like App Service, Azure Storage, Key Vault, Azure Function, Logic-App, etc. Hands-on experience with version control systems and ability to implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for automated builds and deployments. Skilled in debugging and monitoring tools (Postman, Fiddler, Application Insights) for troubleshooting and performance optimization. Understanding of enterprise standards: logging, monitoring, access control, and secure data handling. Knowledge of OOP Concept & software architecture principles, including microservices and SOA. Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) for building low-code/no-code solutions and integrating with enterprise systems. Comfortable working in Agile and traditional waterfall models. Strong English communication skills with ability to work effectively with regional teams. Cross-cultural sensitivity and fully understand and adopt company's values Experience in sizeable multinational corporations to work with large cross-functional teams.

title: [Operational Risk] _IT Risk
jd_text:
1. Tham gia xây dựng, duy trì khung quản lý rủi ro công nghệ (chính sách, quy trình, khẩu vị rủi ro, chỉ số rủi ro trọng yếu - KRI) phù hợp thông lệ quốc tế và quy định của NHNN. 2. Thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro CNTT đối với các hoạt động thay đổi, nâng cấp, triển khai hệ thống mới và xử lý sự cố CNTT. 3. Thực hiện thẩm định rủi ro đối với các giải pháp/công nghệ mới (Fintech, Open Banking, Cloud) trước khi chính thức đưa vào vận hành. 4. Đánh giá rủi ro CNTT của các đối tác, nhà cung cấp dịch vụ thuê ngoài (Outsourcing). 5. Phối hợp giám sát hiệu quả các chốt chặn kiểm soát CNTT, quản lý quyền truy cập và bảo mật thông tin. 6. Tham gia xây dựng, rà soát và trực tiếp giám sát hoạt động kiểm thử kế hoạch duy trì hoạt động kinh doanh (BCP) và khôi phục thảm họa (DRP). 7. Theo dõi rủi ro an ninh mạng (Cyber Risk), phối hợp với Khối CNTT nâng cao mức độ trưởng thành an ninh mạng của Ngân hàng. 8. Giám sát, tổng hợp và báo cáo độc lập về các sự cố CNTT, mức độ ảnh hưởng và hiệu quả khắc phục. 9. Phối hợp với Khối CNTT thực hiện phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ (RCA), giám sát việc triển khai các hành động khắc phục (Action Plan) nhằm hạn chế nguy cơ tái diễn sự cố. 10. Báo cáo Quản trị: Thực hiện các báo cáo định kỳ/đột xuất về rủi ro công nghệ, bao gồm các chỉ số rủi ro trọng yếu (KRI) và mức độ tuân thủ khẩu vị rủi ro, theo yêu cầu của Khối QLRR & PCTT và Ban Lãnh đạo. 11. Đào tạo & Nâng cao nhận thức: Phối hợp xây dựng, triển khai các chương trình đào tạo, truyền thông nhằm nâng cao nhận thức và văn hóa quản lý rủi ro công nghệ trong toàn Ngân hàng.

Tốt nghiệp đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Hệ thống thông tin, An toàn thông tin hoặc lĩnh vực liên quan Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực kiểm soát tuân thủ hoạt động, kiểm soát và đánh giá rủi ro CNTT. Có kiến thức về các nền tảng và thành phần hệ thống CNTT như mạng, bảo mật, máy chủ, lưu trữ, hệ điều hành, cơ sở dữ liệu, lập trình ứng dụng, ... Có kinh nghiệm tham gia triển khai dự án quản lý an ninh thông tin theo tiêu chuẩn ISO/IEC 27001:2013. Am hiểu các khung/tiêu chuẩn quản lý rủi ro công nghệ và an toàn thông tin quốc tế (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS...) và các quy định của Ngân hàng Nhà nước, pháp luật Việt Nam về an toàn hệ thống thông tin, an ninh mạng, bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân. Có hiểu biết về các công nghệ, xu hướng mới nổi trong ngành ngân hàng (Cloud, AI/GenAI, Blockchain...) và các rủi ro công nghệ liên quan. Ưu tiên ứng viên có các chứng chỉ chuyên môn về kiểm toán, an toàn thông tin và quản lý rủi ro công nghệ.

title: Chief Technology Officer (AI, Software Architecture)
jd_text:
Zeya Labs builds the systems, models, and data infrastructure for a group operating across broad industries — including financial services, real estate, retail, healthcare, and more — in Southeast Asia. Real backing, real scale, real stakes. Almost none of it has a technology backbone yet. We are a small AI-native engineering team based in Ho Chi Minh City, and the central technology delivery engine for that group. We are not a consultancy. We do not hand off blueprints. We build, run, and own what we ship. That's the opportunity here: no legacy architecture to inherit, no decade of technical debt to manage around, no entrenched way of doing things to unwind. You'd be one of the first people deciding how this gets built, secured, and run — at group scale, from close to zero. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This is a new, senior role, and it owns the technology function. You report to the CEO and are accountable for everything: architecture, security, testing, how software gets built and run, and the teams that build it — consistently, as we scale into new industries and new group entities. This only works if you stay close to the work. Everyone at Zeya Labs is hands-on, including you. Concretely, the CTO is responsible for three things: Leading AI-native delivery, for real. You've shipped complex AI products into production, not pilots or proofs of concept — this is a hard filter. You know from experience why conventional scrum ceremonies and fixed pods are often the wrong shape for AI-native work, and you have an actual point of view on what to run instead. Owning the engineering organization. Building and running the team as it scales — hiring, developing engineering leadership under you, and being the technical voice the board and senior stakeholders trust without needing it re-explained. Building the operating system. Designing the standards for architecture, security, testing, and delivery before scale forces them on us — not after an incident makes them unavoidable.

You have built engineering structure at an organizational level before — standards, governance, how work actually gets done — not just run a team executing inside a structure someone else designed. That's the differentiator. Plenty of people can manage delivery well; what's rare is having built the system delivery runs on, and having done it ahead of a crisis, not in response to one. You have genuine, delivered experience shipping AI-integrated systems into production — not coursework, not demos, not a certification. You understand where AI tooling helps, where it creates fragility, and how conventional team structures often fight against how AI-native work actually gets done. You are still hands-on and technically credible, not someone who has moved fully into frameworks and slides. Ideally you've worked inside financial services or another regulated environment, since parts of this group carry real compliance weight. You are comfortable holding your own in a board or governance conversation without hiding behind jargon. You'd rather design the system once than firefight the same problem in every new team. You can go from setting direction to getting hands-on when something needs it, without it feeling like a step down. You're motivated by scale and blank space, not by inheriting something already built.

title: Data Engineer (English required, Ho Chi Minh/Ha Noi)
jd_text:
We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and enterprise-wide data platforms to power AI-driven healthcare automation systems. You will have the opportunity to work alongside one of Southeast Asia’s leading AI teams, applying cutting-edge AI and LLM technologies to solve complex, real-world healthcare challenges at scale. From enabling agentic automate processing to building AI-ready data lakes, this role sits at the core of our regional AI transformation journey. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines (batch + near real-time) - Integrate data from multiple sources (Claims, Member Data, Finance, APIs, Applications, CMS) - Build and optimize data models for analytics and AI training - Work with Azure Data Services (Blob, Data Lake, Azure SQL, Service Bus, etc.) - Ensure data quality, validation, and logging mechanisms - Support AI model training by preparing structured datasets - Assist in building dashboards for operations monitoring

- Because of recruitment needs, we accept Vietnamese candidates only - 2–5 years of experience in Data Engineering - Strong Python + SQL skills - Experience with data pipelines (Airflow / Prefect / Azure Data Factory / similar) - Familiar with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) - Experience handling structured + semi-structured data - Experience leveraging AI/ML techniques to enhance data processing, database optimization, data quality monitoring, or intelligent data workflows is a plus - Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate effectively with regional and global stakeholder is a plus

title: Fullstack Developer (.NET, ReactJS)
jd_text:
Job Description: We are looking for a skilled Fullstack Developer with strong experience in .NET (C#) for backend development and React.js for frontend interfaces. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end web applications that are robust, scalable, and user-friendly. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the entire technology stack and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop high-quality web applications using ASP.NET Core for the backend and React.js for the frontend Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, and other developers to implement new features Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code across both frontend and backend layers Create and consume RESTful APIs and ensure seamless data exchange between client and server Integrate third-party services and APIs as required Ensure application performance, scalability, and security Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and quality Maintain documentation and contribute to continuous process improvements

Required skills/Experience: 2 years of experience in .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) backend development 2 years of hands-on experience with React.js, Redux, and modern JavaScript (ES6+) Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework, or other ORM tools Familiarity with frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and package managers (npm, yarn) Experience with REST APIs, web services, and client-server architecture Proficient with Git and version control workflows Solid understanding of software development best practices, including Agile methodologies Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (Software Engineering). title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js, React, Java, Kotlin)
jd_text:
Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team’s health, code quality and nonfunctional requirements. You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way. You will apply the latest technology thinking from our to solve client problems You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

You have experience as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, React, TypeScript, and Java , alongside exposure to Kotlin. You are comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools and agents responsibly and effectively in your workflow. You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable with Object-Oriented programming You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools Bonus points if you have working knowledge of cloud technology such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and Docker You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed Presence in the external tech community: you willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

title: Project Manager (Insurance)
jd_text:
Techcom Life – A Proud Member of Techcombank Ecosystem As part of Techcombank’s integrated financial ecosystem, Techcom Life is built on a strong foundation of Health and Wealth , with a mission to empower individuals to live life to the fullest. We accompany each customer on their journey to achieve their aspirations, delivering holistic financial and well-being solutions that create lasting value. Guided by the belief that true growth comes from the harmony of strength, security, and balance, Techcom Life brings together innovation, expertise, and care to help life grow bigger every day. JOB PURPOSE - The job holder leads portfolio management by providing support in planning, coordination of financial objectives and deliverables for the portfolio of both traditional projects/initiatives implemented through Waterfall methodology and customer journey digitization initiatives implemented through Agile methodology. - The job holder collaborates with cross-functional teams within the Transformation Office and other divisions in the company to ensure operational consistency across company initiatives in tracking and governing progress, managing resources and communicating with stakeholders. Key Accountabilities A. Operations Support and Governance - Design the operational process across the initiative lifecycle to ensure standartized approach across all type of initiatives/projects. - Update operational processes on a regular basis and facilitate the set up of new initiatives and tribes in accordance with required standards. - Support the development of tools/templates and guide initiative teams on how to fill in and update initiative progress on the tools/templates created. - Apply and maintain tools/templates used to track and report across the portfolio of transformation initiatives (Foundational and Agile), define monitoring tools/templates and customize as needed. - Provide logistics support head of division and the team, CEO workshops, governance meetings, and be the contact point for building the Agile working environment. - Consolidate and prepare progress reports for BOM, BOD and related committees timely and accurately. B. Resource Management - Collaborate with stakeholders in Business Units / Divisions to identify high level resource planning requirements to ensure optimal resource utilization. - Track and control resource usage efficiency to ensure sufficiency for all units in division and for company initiatives within approved plan. C. Portfolio Management - Work with transformation initiative leads and teams to understand progress of their assigned portfolio and track the accuracy of inputs for tools. - Work with initiative leads to change initiative status and solve problems as required, report key challenges, track progress, recognize financial values and manage use of monitoring tools. - Proactively guide initiative teams, Business Units and Divisions for effective cross-functional collaboration. - Control quality and compliance of initiatives with required standards. - Escalate issues or risks of potential impact on performance via portfolio reporting to Sponsors, committees to facilitate the decision making process. - Support to develop Early Warning System (EWS).

Qualifications and Work Experience - At least 08 years of project or program management experience in Waterfall or Agile methodologies - Project or program management experience in a financial service or technology organization including product development, performance management, IT project implementation - Demonstrated experience working in a transformation office to drive a large organization-wide transformation program - Strong experience in performance tracking and management including operating rhythm of performance reviews - Strong knowledge and experience in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit large, complex, mission-critical, enterprise-level projects - Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Technology, Business, Banking and Finance or relevant discipline - Project management certification in PMP, PgMP will be advantageous

jd_text:
1. BỐI CẢNH VÀ NHIỆM VỤMetric.vn là startup công nghệ dữ liệu dẫn đầu mảng phân tích và cung cấp dữ liệu thị trường E-commerce cho các nhãn hàng (Brand) và công ty bán lẻ (Retail).Dữ liệu thị trường chỉ là một phần trong toàn bộ data system của một doanh nghiệp. Trong kỷ nguyên AI, mọi data system đều cần phải AI-ready - sao cho khi tích hợp ChatGPT, Claude hay Gemini thì các AI này luôn nắm bắt được context doanh nghiệp và hoạt động hiệu quả nhất. Một data system đã AI-ready như thế gọi là data brain, Metric đang tiếp tục hướng đến vị trí dẫn đầu trong việc cung cấp giải pháp data brain này. Tên sản phẩm: Smart BI.Với vai trò Senior PO, bạn có nhiệm vụ làm cho mỗi khách hàng có một Data Brain cho riêng họ thông qua sử dụng sản phẩm Smart BI này.2. VAI TRÒ VÀ TRÁCH NHIỆM- Sở hữu Product roadmap: Đảm bảo product roadmap luôn được cập nhật theo nhu cầu từ khách hàng và stakeholders. Chịu trách nhiệm deliver tới khách hàng và stakeholders (kinh doanh, công ty).- Chịu trách nhiệm về product values: Xây dựng feature list và PRD, đảm bảo bám sát nhất với nhu cầu thị trường, Khách hàng, kỳ vọng Kinh doanh của công ty.- Thiết kế tiêu chuẩn sản phẩm: Thiết kế logic, rule xử lý data và thiết kế UI/UX cho các luồng từ đồng bộ data đến khi được sử dụng thành công trong các AI Agents của khách hàng. Bạn cũng thiết kế các gói trả phí phù hợp theo nhu cầu kinh doanh.- Đồng thiết kế giải pháp Enterprise: Làm việc sát sườn với các Solution Consultant trong các deal Custom Enterprise lớn.- Đồng quản trị nguồn lực kỹ thuật: Cùng với Product Head, bạn dẫn dắt engineer team với tư cách owner của Product roadmap và PRD, nắm rõ nguồn lực engineering trong sản phẩm để thiết kế giá gói sản phẩm & quản lý rủi ro nợ kỹ thuật.- KPIs của bạn: Product values (stakeholders đánh giá); Feature adoption; Delivery SLA;

Kinh nghiệm bắt buộc:- Có ít nhất 4 năm kinh nghiệm làm Product Owner hoặc Senior Product Executive tại các công ty SaaS, ưu tiên các SaaS có tính chất phức tạp về luồng dữ liệu (ERP, CRM, CDP, Hệ thống quản lý bán hàng đa kênh);- Ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm thiết kế các phần mềm hoặc hệ thống có tính năng Phân quyền người dùng và Quản trị dữ liệu phức tạp.- Ưu tiên: Ứng viên từng trải qua các vị trí tương tự về AI SaaS; PO gốc kỹ thuật chuyển định hướng Product & Customer; PO/PM của các SaaS ngành E-commerce & Digital.Năng lực chuyên môn:- Mạnh tư duy hệ thống và tối ưu.- Nhạy bén về data thương mại hoặc data phục vụ tăng trưởng.- Định hướng chuyên môn các sản phẩm data platform & ứng dụng AIVăn hóa & Tính cách:- Chủ động, quyết liệt, linh hoạt.- Khéo léo trong giao tiếp, phối hợp.- Kiên nhẫn, kiên định với tầm nhìn sản phẩm.- Học tập liên tục, dám nghĩ dám làm.

title: QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Tester)
jd_text:
We are looking for a talented Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing) to join our growing Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality web and mobile applications. You will perform both manual and automated testing activities, contribute to quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle, and help drive a quality-first mindset across Agile teams. You will have opportunities to work on enterprise-scale Banking and Insurance projects, utilizing modern testing tools, automation frameworks, API testing solutions, and CI/CD practices. Responsibilities Analyze business and system requirements to create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios. Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, and user acceptance testing for web and mobile applications. Design, execute, and maintain automated test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency. Conduct API testing and validate system integrations. Support shift-left testing practices by participating early in requirement reviews and development activities. Collaborate closely with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Identify, document, track, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle. Review solution documentation and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. Prepare test execution reports and communicate testing progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, automation frameworks, test data management, and testing standards.

Must Have 2-10 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong experience in manual testing, including functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing. Hands-on experience with test automation for web, mobile, or API testing. Experience with at least one automation tool or framework such as: Selenium WebDriver Cypress Katalon Studio TestComplete Or similar automation frameworks Selenium WebDriver Cypress Katalon Studio TestComplete Or similar automation frameworks Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or equivalent. Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and QA best practices. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Experience using Jira and related collaboration/testing tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Nice to Have Experience with Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Groovy, Python, or similar programming languages. Experience with Mobile Automation Testing. Experience maintaining or enhancing automation frameworks. Knowledge of SQL and database testing. Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or CI/CD pipelines. Experience with test management tools such as Xray, Zephyr, qTest, or similar. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance domains. ISTQB or relevant testing certifications.
